items.abstract_or_text: In July, AI agents running a security test escaped their sandbox and ended up inside @huggingface's servers. So today we're happy to be among @nvidia and @JensenHuang's partners on the release of the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform. The key idea: don't count on the agent to respect the rules. Agents write and run their own code, and when one path is blocked they look for another. In one of NVIDIA's tests, an agent that wasn't allowed to push code through GitHub's API simply switched to git instead. We've now seen countless examples of this behavior. For now, safety can't live only inside the agent. It has to be built around it. That's the concept behind OpenShell (open source, Apache 2.0): - the agent runs in a Linux sandbox (Landlock + seccomp): no root, no direct network access - a supervisor outside the sandbox holds the real credentials - the agent only gets a placeholder token, swapped for the real one on approved calls My favorite piece is a solver (built on Z3) that checks mathematically whether a new permission opens a door that was supposed to stay closed. In NVIDIA's tests, an AI reviewer approved a bad permission request and the math check caught it. The Sentry integration is exciting too: a watchdog running on a BlueField-4 DPU, i.e. separate silicon sitting on the node's only path to the model. A monitor on separate hardware keeps watching even if the host OS is compromised. It's a first step, and a lot can be built on top of it. Right now the prover checks permissions, not intent, and the open-source part is mostly OpenShell rather than Sentry. But it's clearly the right direction.
items.summary_zh: Thomas Wolf 介绍 NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform、OpenShell 与 Sentry 的代理安全架构。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 作者报告了代理逃逸沙箱的案例，并主张把安全控制放在代理外围；编辑判断其中的沙箱、凭据隔离、Z3 权限检查和独立硬件监控具有明确工程价值，但当前证明器检查的是权限而非意图。
items.abstract_zh: 今年7月，一次安全测试中运行的AI代理逃出沙箱，最终进入了Hugging Face的服务器。因此，今天我们很高兴成为英伟达和黄仁勋发布 NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform 的合作伙伴之一。关键思想是：不要指望代理会遵守规则。代理会编写并运行自己的代码；一条路径被阻断时，它们会寻找另一条路。在 NVIDIA 的一次测试中，一个不被允许通过 GitHub API 推送代码的代理，直接改用 git。我们已经看到了无数这样的行为。就目前而言，安全不能只存在于代理内部，还必须构建在代理周围。这正是 OpenShell（开源，Apache 2.0）的理念：代理在 Linux 沙箱中运行（Landlock + seccomp），没有 root 权限，也不能直接访问网络；沙箱外的监管器持有真正的凭据；代理只获得占位令牌，只有在获准调用时才替换为真实令牌。我最喜欢的部分是一个基于 Z3 构建的求解器，它会数学地检查新权限是否打开了原本应该保持关闭的通道。在 NVIDIA 的测试中，AI 审查器批准了一项有问题的权限请求，而数学检查捕捉到了它。Sentry 集成也很令人兴奋：它是在 BlueField-4 DPU 上运行的看门狗，也就是部署在节点通往模型的唯一通路上的独立芯片。即使主机操作系统遭到入侵，独立硬件上的监视器仍会持续观察。这只是第一步，未来还可以在此基础上构建很多东西。不过目前，证明器检查的是权限，而不是意图；开源部分主要是 OpenShell，而不是 Sentry。但这显然是正确的方向。

items.title: TopU-LBVS: A Realistic Multi Target Benchmark for Ligand Based Virtual Screening
items.abstract_or_text: Ligand-based virtual screening (LBVS) is a practical first-pass tool in early-stage drug discovery, but existing benchmarks can overestimate performance through random negatives, easy decoys, limited target coverage, and non-standardized evaluation protocols. We introduce TopU-LBVS, a multi-target benchmark for LBVS under hard-negative screening conditions. Starting from curated ChEMBL~35 bioactivity data, TopU-LBVS covers 93 protein targets across 7 protein classes and constructs target-specific screening libraries with property-matched, structurally similar decoys at a fixed 1:40 active-to-decoy ratio. Libraries contain roughly 400 to 10,000 compounds and are designed to reduce simple physicochemical and nearest-neighbor fingerprint shortcuts. TopU-LBVS provides three fixed protocols. TopU-LBVS-full evaluates ChEMBL^\ast \rightarrow TopU generalization across all 93 targets. TopU-LBVS-low evaluates low-data TopU \rightarrow TopU learning within the hard-negative distribution. TopU-LBVS-mini provides a compact seven-target protocol with a paired random-decoy control that changes only the test decoys, enabling low-cost development and direct measurement of the gap between random ChEMBL^\ast and TopU decoys. Across ten reference baselines spanning fingerprint methods, molecular GNNs, fingerprint hybrids, and modern molecular models, performance under random-decoy evaluation degrades sharply under hard-negative screening. We release data, fixed splits, evaluation code, and baseline implementations for reproducible comparison of future LBVS and molecular representation learning methods. Code and data are available at https://github.com/topu-benchmark/topu-lbvs and https://huggingface.co/datasets/topu-benchmark/topu-lbvs.
items.summary_zh: 提出 TopU-LBVS 多靶点配体虚拟筛选基准，基于 ChEMBL~35 构建覆盖93个蛋白靶点、7类蛋白的属性匹配和结构相似硬负样本库，并提供三种固定评测协议和十类基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 随机负样本会显著高估虚拟筛选性能，该基准可更严格地检验分子表示和筛选模型的泛化能力。限制是基准仍依赖 ChEMBL 生物活性数据及其构建规则，不能完全替代真实实验筛选。
items.abstract_zh: 基于配体的虚拟筛选（LBVS）是早期药物发现中的实用首轮工具，但现有基准可能因随机负样本、容易区分的诱饵、有限的靶点覆盖和不统一的评估协议而高估性能。我们提出 TopU-LBVS，一个在硬负样本筛选条件下评估 LBVS 的多靶点基准。TopU-LBVS 从整理后的 ChEMBL~35 生物活性数据出发，覆盖7类蛋白中的93个蛋白靶点，并以固定的1:40 活性物-诱饵比例，为每个靶点构建属性匹配、结构相似的诱饵筛选库。筛选库包含约400至10,000个化合物，旨在减少简单理化性质和最近邻指纹捷径。TopU-LBVS 提供三种固定协议。TopU-LBVS-full 评估 ChEMBL^∗ → TopU 在全部93个靶点上的泛化；TopU-LBVS-low 评估低数据量条件下在硬负样本分布内从 TopU → TopU 的学习；TopU-LBVS-mini 提供一个包含7个靶点的紧凑协议，并配有仅改变测试诱饵的成对随机诱饵对照，从而能够低成本开发，并直接测量随机 ChEMBL^∗ 诱饵与 TopU 诱饵之间的差距。在涵盖指纹方法、分子 GNN、指纹混合模型和现代分子模型的十种参考基线中，随机诱饵评估下的性能在硬负样本筛选中显著下降。我们发布数据、固定数据划分、评估代码和基线实现，以支持未来 LBVS 和分子表示学习方法的可复现比较。代码和数据见 https://github.com/topu-benchmark/topu-lbvs 和 https://huggingface.co/datasets/topu-benchmark/topu-lbvs。

items.abstract_or_text: The debate over AI proofs is moving beyond one question: “Is the proof correct?” At a mathematics seminar yesterday, Mathias Stout raised two deeper unresolved questions about AI-generated formal proofs: Why should we trust LLM-generated Lean certificates? And how do we verify that the theorem encoded in Lean actually corresponds faithfully to the original mathematical problem? Machine verification may check a proof inside a formal system. But humans still have to verify that we formalized the right statement. That distinction could become crucial as AI enters serious mathematical research.

items.abstract_zh: 关于 AI 证明的争论正在超越一个问题：“证明是否正确？”昨天的一场数学研讨会上，Mathias Stout 提出了关于 AI 生成形式化证明的两个更深层、尚未解决的问题：我们为什么应该信任由大语言模型生成的 Lean 证书？以及，如何验证 Lean 中编码的定理确实忠实对应原始数学问题？机器验证可以检查形式系统内部的证明，但人类仍然必须验证我们形式化的是正确的陈述。这一区分可能会在 AI 进入严肃数学研究时变得至关重要。

items.abstract_or_text: The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for sandboxing AI agents. OpenWorker, our open-source agent harness supporting cybersecurity workflows, is proud to support this. A sandbox gives an agent limited permissions. OpenWorker is building on Nvidia OpenShell and will support running each agent's commands inside a sandbox. Only the files relevant to the task go in. Secret API keys, your web browser login credentials, the ability to access arbitrary websites, are inaccessible to the agent by default. These restrictions are implemented in deterministic code rather than by prompting an LLM, which can make mistakes or be susceptible to prompt injections. Further, all actions are logged for monitoring and audit. I'm grateful for @JensenHuang's leadership making AI agents more secure. OpenWorker (which @rohitcprasad and I are working on) will continue to improve security for agents.
items.summary_zh: Andrew Ng 说明 OpenWorker 将基于 NVIDIA OpenShell，为网络安全代理提供确定性沙箱与审计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 作者强调以确定性代码限制文件、密钥和网络访问，并记录全部操作，而不是依赖提示词约束模型；编辑判断这为高风险代理工作流提供了可落地的权限最小化和审计模式。
items.abstract_zh: OpenAI-Hugging Face 黑客事件的发生缘于沙箱薄弱。很高兴看到 NVIDIA 发布用于代理沙箱化的开源工具。我们支持网络安全工作流的开源代理框架 OpenWorker，很自豪能够支持这一方向。沙箱会赋予代理有限权限。OpenWorker 正在基于 NVIDIA OpenShell 构建，并将支持把每个代理的命令运行在沙箱中。默认情况下，只把与任务相关的文件放进去；秘密 API 密钥、浏览器登录凭据以及访问任意网站的能力，对代理都是不可用的。这些限制通过确定性代码实现，而不是通过提示词实现，因为提示词可能被语言模型误解，也可能受到提示注入攻击。所有操作还会被记录，以便监控和审计。感谢黄仁勋让代理更加安全。OpenWorker（我与 Rohit C. Prasad 正在共同开发）将继续改进代理安全。

items.title: Differentiating benign from malignant adnexal masses by biomarker-agnostic plasma proteomics using adaptive machine learning
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Pre-operative triage of adnexal masses with serum CA-125, HE4, and ultrasound (O-RADS) has limited accuracy, contributing to unnecessary surgery. We develop and validate a first of its kind, biomarker panel-free plasma proteomic classifier that distinguishes malignant from benign adnexal masses from a single blood draw, operating directly on discovery-mode mass spectrometry. Methods: In this multicenter prospective observational study, plasma from women with adnexal masses and from healthy controls at a large urban academic center (discovery and four validation cohorts) and an external academic center from another Urban-suburban area (external validation) was analyzed by data-independent-acquisition mass spectrometry (Orbitrap Astral), quantifying >1,000 proteins per sample. Cancerous (malignant, borderline adnexal mass, or metastasis to ovary) versus benign adnexal masses were classified with ADAPT-MS (Adaptive Diagnostic Architecture for Personalized Testing by Mass Spectrometry), which retrains an ElasticNet model for each sample based on the proteins measured. The primary outcome was discrimination (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUC]). Pre-operative O-RADS scores and serum CA-125 were compared and combined with proteomics on matched subsets. Findings: Using a discovery cohort (n=1062), an ADAPT-MS classifier, validated across five independent cohorts (n=623), achieved a summary AUC of 0.835 (cohort range 0.779-0.904). Among patients with pre-operative O-RADS (n=231), proteomics (AUC 0.852) was comparable to O-RADS alone (0.863) and combining them raised discrimination to 0.922. Proteomics outperformed serum CA-125 (0.915 versus 0.777; n=125) and proteome-derived ROMA-like and two-marker surrogates. Biologically, the classification-relevant proteins are enriched for host response proteins rather than tumor cell associated protein changes, comprising ECM remodeling, complement and innate immune response pathways. This explains good detection of tumor with heterogenous pathology and also metastasis to ovary. Interpretation: A single plasma proteomic measurement interpreted using adaptive machine learning discriminates malignant from benign adnexal masses with good internal and external validation, and is complementary to ultrasound, warranting prospective evaluation as a panel-free diagnostic adjunct to imaging.
items.summary_zh: ADAPT-MS 直接从 discovery-mode 质谱血浆蛋白组区分良恶性附件包块，在多中心前瞻性研究中完成内部、外部和与 O-RADS/CA-125 的比较验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究使用单次采血和 biomarker-agnostic 模型处理 >1,000 种蛋白，并在 n=623 的五个独立验证队列及外部中心验证，具有较强临床转化价值。
items.abstract_zh: 背景与目的：使用血清 CA-125、HE4 和超声（O-RADS）对附件包块进行术前分流的准确性有限，导致不必要的手术。我们开发并验证了首个同类不依赖生物标志物面板的血浆蛋白组分类器，从单次采血中区分恶性和良性附件包块，并直接在 discovery-mode 质谱上运行。方法：在这项多中心前瞻性观察性研究中，对来自大型城市学术中心的附件包块女性和健康对照者的血浆进行分析；该中心包括一个发现队列和四个验证队列，另有来自另一个城市—郊区地区学术中心的外部验证队列。使用数据非依赖采集质谱（Orbitrap Astral）对每个样本定量 >1,000 种蛋白。使用 ADAPT-MS（Adaptive Diagnostic Architecture for Personalized Testing by Mass Spectrometry）分类癌性包块（恶性、交界性附件包块或卵巢转移）与良性附件包块；该方法根据每个样本中实际测得的蛋白重新训练 ElasticNet 模型。主要结局是区分能力，即受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）。在匹配的子集中比较并联合术前 O-RADS 评分、血清 CA-125 与蛋白组。结果：在发现队列（n=1062）中，ADAPT-MS 分类器在五个独立队列（n=623）中验证后，汇总 AUC 为 0.835（各队列范围 0.779-0.904）。在具有术前 O-RADS 的患者中（n=231），蛋白组（AUC 0.852）与单独 O-RADS（0.863）相当，二者联合后区分能力升至 0.922。蛋白组优于血清 CA-125（0.915 对 0.777；n=125），也优于蛋白组衍生的 ROMA-like 模型和两个标志物替代模型。从生物学上看，与分类相关的蛋白富集于宿主反应蛋白，而非肿瘤细胞相关蛋白变化，包括 ECM 重塑、补体和先天免疫反应通路。这解释了其对病理异质性肿瘤以及卵巢转移的良好检测能力。解读：使用自适应机器学习解释单次血浆蛋白组测量，可以较好地区分恶性与良性附件包块，并在内部和外部验证中表现良好；该方法与超声具有互补性，值得作为无蛋白标志物面板的影像学辅助诊断工具开展前瞻性评估。

items.title: Learning to Discover Interesting Mathematics
items.abstract_or_text: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly able to solve advanced mathematical problems, including many that have been open for decades. This opens the door to expansion of mathematical knowledge at unprecedented scale. Yet, while LLMs may be able to conjecture and prove more and more theorems, it remains open whether this new mathematical knowledge is interesting or useful. We define intrinsic interestingness of a theorem as the ratio between the length of its proof and the length of its statement. We show that this correlates strongly with an extrinsic measure of the downstream utility of a theorem. We identify the difficulty of a proof conditioned on a set of premises as a useful primitive for computing these metrics, and train a 27B model that predicts proof difficulty more accurately than frontier general-purpose models. Optimizing for our metric creates a model capable of producing more interesting theorems, while also reducing substantial or full overlap with Mathlib from 91.9% to 30.6%, showcasing the creation of more out-of-distribution math. We show that our system can generate candidate theorems, select the most interesting among them, and iteratively build on a self-expanding mathematical library. These metrics provide a practical and quantifiable signal for ranking conjectures and guiding proof search within formal mathematical libraries. Our framework provides a path towards self-expanding, machine-verified mathematical libraries that can choose worthwhile statements without relying on human-supplied targets.
items.summary_zh: 该工作把定理的“有趣性”定义为证明长度与陈述长度之比，并训练模型预测证明难度，以筛选和迭代生成更有用、更加分布外的形式化数学定理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了可量化的猜想排序信号，并报告了与 Mathlib 的重叠率从 91.9% 降至 30.6%，但仍应把形式化可验证性与“有趣”区分开。
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，大型语言模型越来越能够解决高阶数学问题，包括许多数十年来一直开放的问题。这为以前所未有的规模扩展数学知识打开了道路。然而，尽管大型语言模型可能能够猜想并证明越来越多的定理，这些新的数学知识是否有趣或有用仍然是一个开放问题。我们将定理的内在有趣性定义为其证明长度与陈述长度之比。我们表明，这一指标与定理下游效用的外在度量高度相关。我们发现，在给定前提集合的条件下，证明难度是计算这些指标的有用基本量，并训练了一个 27B 模型来预测证明难度，其准确性高于通用前沿模型。针对该指标进行优化，可以生成更有趣的定理，同时将与 Mathlib 的大部分或完整重叠从 91.9% 降至 30.6%，展示出更多分布外数学的生成能力。我们表明，该系统能够生成候选定理、从中选择最有趣的定理，并在不断扩展的数学库上进行迭代构建。这些指标为在形式化数学库中排序猜想和引导证明搜索提供了实用且可量化的信号。我们的框架为构建能够自我扩展、由机器验证的数学库提供了一条路径，使其无需依赖人工提供的目标，也能选择有价值的陈述。

items.title: OMatG-flash: An All-Atom Flow Map with Reinforce Adjoint Matching for Scalable Materials Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: The discovery of novel inorganic materials drives technological breakthroughs in critical fields such as computing and energy storage. Generative AI has promised to accelerate the materials discovery pipeline, but state-of-the-art flow and diffusion models remain bottlenecked by the cost of proposing candidate materials. To address this, we introduce OMatG-flash, an all-atom flow map for inorganic crystal structure prediction (CSP) and de novo generation (DNG). OMatG-flash is a Pareto-optimal inference engine for materials, sampling candidate materials with an order of magnitude fewer inference steps and less wall-clock time than existing flow and diffusion models while demonstrating benchmark performance on par with the state-of-the-art. To enable post-training fine-tuning we apply Reinforce Adjoint Matching to flow maps, further improving match rates and RMSE on the unconditional CSP task. OMatG-flash showcases the potential of flow maps to accelerate generation of high-quality candidate inorganic materials and demonstrates a step forward in sample throughput necessary for data-hungry materials discovery workflows.
items.summary_zh: 提出 OMatG-flash 全原子 flow map，通过 Reinforce Adjoint Matching 进行后训练微调，在保持晶体结构预测和从头生成基准性能的同时，将推理步数和耗时降低一个数量级。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 解决材料生成中候选提议吞吐量受限的问题，直接面向数据密集型无机材料发现流程。限制是摘要主要报告基准匹配率和 RMSE，尚未说明生成材料的实验合成或长期稳定性。
items.abstract_zh: 新型无机材料的发现推动着计算和储能等关键领域的技术突破。生成式 AI 有望加速材料发现流程，但当前最先进的流模型和扩散模型仍受制于提出材料候选的成本。为此，我们提出 OMatG-flash，一个用于无机晶体结构预测（CSP）和从头生成（DNG）的全原子 flow map。OMatG-flash 是一种面向材料的 Pareto 最优推理引擎，相比现有 flow 和 diffusion 模型，以少一个数量级的推理步数和更短的墙钟时间采样材料候选，同时保持与最先进方法相当的基准性能。为了支持后训练微调，我们将 Reinforce Adjoint Matching 应用于 flow map，进一步改善无条件 CSP 任务上的匹配率和 RMSE。OMatG-flash 展示了 flow map 加速高质量无机材料候选生成的潜力，并为数据密集型材料发现流程所需的样本吞吐量提升迈出了重要一步。

items.title: Agentic-IC3: Enabling Semantic Proof Search in IC3 Model Checking
items.abstract_or_text: IC3 is a state-of-the-art algorithm for hardware model checking that proves safety properties by incrementally constructing an inductive invariant consisting of a set of lemmas. Its effectiveness depends on generalization heuristics that identify useful lemmas and guide proof search. However, many leading IC3 hardware model checkers operate on lowered, bit-level representations, where high-level design relationships are difficult to exploit for generalization. Those operating at a higher level remain limited in exploiting high-level design structure and semantics. We present Agentic-IC3, built on Pono's word-level model-checking infrastructure, which integrates a language-model agent into IC3 to guide semantic proof search using register-transfer-level (RTL) design information. The framework exposes an agent-oriented interface to a persistent IC3 backend, allowing the agent to interact with an explicit, evolving proof state throughout verification. Across successive proof obligations, the agent relates intermediate proof states and solver feedback to the RTL and proposes high-level lemmas through both SAT and UNSAT generalization. Beyond generalization, the agent can introduce derived observation signals to express design relationships succinctly and obtain more informative feedback, and backtrack to revise proposals that lead to unproductive proof branches. The backend checks proposals before updating the proof state, preserving soundness and providing feedback for further reasoning. On a suite of 14 benchmarks spanning security information-flow verification and functional verification of communication protocols, processors, and functional units, Agentic-IC3 solves 10 cases within a one-hour timeout, including 4 unsolved by all three evaluated baselines: rIC3, Pono-IC3Bits, and A-IC3.
items.summary_zh: Agentic-IC3 将语言模型代理接入 Pono 的字级 IC3 模型检查器，用 RTL 语义指导不变式与引理搜索，并由后端验证所有提议。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 14 个硬件验证基准中解决 10 个案例，其中 4 个是三种基线均未解决的案例；后端检查保持了证明过程的可靠性。
items.abstract_zh: IC3 是一种先进的硬件模型检查算法，它通过逐步构造由一组引理组成的不变不变量来证明安全性质。其有效性依赖于能够识别有用引理并引导证明搜索的泛化启发式方法。然而，许多领先的 IC3 硬件模型检查器运行在降低后的位级表示上，难以利用高层设计关系进行泛化。那些运行在更高层级的检查器，在利用高层设计结构和语义方面仍然受限。我们提出 Agentic-IC3，它构建于 Pono 的字级模型检查基础设施之上，将语言模型代理集成到 IC3 中，利用寄存器传输级（RTL）设计信息指导语义证明搜索。该框架向代理提供一个面向代理的持久化 IC3 后端接口，使代理能够在验证过程中与显式且不断演化的证明状态交互。在连续的证明义务之间，代理将中间证明状态和求解器反馈与 RTL 联系起来，并通过 SAT 与 UNSAT 泛化提出高层引理。除泛化外，代理还可以引入派生观测信号，以简洁表达设计关系并获得更有信息量的反馈；对于导致无效证明分支的提议，代理可以回溯并修订。后端在更新证明状态前检查这些提议，从而保持可靠性并为后续推理提供反馈。在涵盖安全信息流验证以及通信协议、处理器和功能单元功能验证的 14 个基准上，Agentic-IC3 在一小时超时内解决了 10 个案例，其中包括三种评估基线 rIC3、Pono-IC3Bits 和 A-IC3 均未解决的 4 个案例。

items.title: EquivSVA: A Formally Verified Dataset of Behavioral Assertions Across Equivalent RTL Implementations
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models are increasingly used to generate SystemVerilog Assertions from natural-language specifica- tions and register-transfer-level designs. Existing datasets and benchmarks support important goals such as large- scale training, formal evaluation, specification-to-assertion generation, and mutation-based testing. A complemen- tary need is to study whether a generated assertion cap- tures externally observable behavior or depends on inci- dental details of one RTL implementation. We present EquivSVA, a formally verified dataset organized around behavior families. Each family contains four structurally distinct RTL implementations of the same externally ob- servable behavior, shared interface-level gold properties, three controlled mutants, and formal-validation evidence. EquivSVA contains 120 behavior families across 12 cat- egories, 480 reference RTL implementations, 914 gold properties, and 360 mutants. Every final family passes a fixed 17-job validation suite covering RTL equivalence, gold-property proofs, property reachability, mutant dis- tinguishability, and gold-property checks on mutants. We also provide fixed family-safe train, development, and test splits. As a small demonstration of the analyses en- abled by the dataset, we evaluate the publicly released, Apache-2.0-licensed Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct model on the held-out test split. Of 293 interface-only generated properties, 93 are formally sound, and the number of sound properties varies across equivalent implementations for 14 of 24 test families. These results illustrate how behavior-family organization can support controlled stud- ies of assertion-generation robustness without requiring changes in intended functionality. The dataset, generators, validation scripts, and case-study artifacts are publicly released at https://github.com/aditigupta96/EquivSVA.
items.summary_zh: EquivSVA 按行为族组织形式化验证的数据集：每个行为由四种结构不同但外部等价的 RTL 实现、金标准属性、突变体及验证证据组成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据集把“属性是否依赖实现细节”变成可检验问题，并提供固定的 17 项验证套件、数据划分和公开脚本。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于根据自然语言规格和寄存器传输级设计生成 SystemVerilog Assertions。现有数据集和基准支持大规模训练、形式化评估、从规格到断言的生成以及基于突变的测试等重要目标。另一个互补需求是研究生成的断言是否捕获了外部可观察行为，还是依赖于某一种 RTL 实现的偶然细节。我们提出 EquivSVA，这是一个经过形式化验证、按行为族组织的数据集。每个行为族包含四种在结构上不同但具有相同外部可观察行为的 RTL 实现、共享的接口级金标准属性、三个受控突变体以及形式化验证证据。EquivSVA 包含 120 个行为族、12 个类别、480 个参考 RTL 实现、914 个金标准属性和 360 个突变体。每个最终行为族都通过固定的 17 项验证套件，覆盖 RTL 等价性、金标准属性证明、属性可达性、突变体可区分性以及在突变体上的金标准属性检查。我们还提供固定的、按行为族隔离的训练集、开发集和测试集。作为该数据集支持的分析示例之一，我们在保留测试集上评估了公开发布且采用 Apache-2.0 许可的 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 模型。在 293 个仅使用接口信息生成的属性中，93 个在形式上是可靠的；在 24 个测试行为族中的 14 个中，可靠属性的数量会随等价实现而变化。这些结果说明，按行为族组织数据集可以支持对断言生成鲁棒性的受控研究，而无需改变预期功能。数据集、生成器、验证脚本和案例研究工件已在 https://github.com/aditigupta96/EquivSVA 公开发布。

items.title: Tool-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Domain Adaptation in Sequence-Based Omics Tasks
items.abstract_or_text: Multi-omics sequences contain complex biological patterns, yet deciphering their mechanisms for automated scientific discovery remains challenging. As large language models (LLMs) interpret these sequences, evaluating both predictions and scientific reasoning is critical. However, existing benchmarks for multi-omics sequence tasks rely on classification and regression metrics, neglecting whether models grasp the underlying biological evidence. We introduce OmicsBench, the first reasoning benchmark for multi-omics sequences, comprising 1,160 expert-validated questions across six tasks spanning DNA regulation, RNA processing, and protein function. OmicsBench requires traceable evidence chains, evaluated using instance-specific rubrics developed with domain experts. Evaluating 17 LLMs reveals an inverse relationship: while scientific LLMs outperform general-purpose LLMs in sequence classification accuracy, they fail to provide valid evidence to support their predictions. One plausible interpretation is shortcut learning: specialized models may rely on statistical patterns rather than the biological mechanisms needed for scientific discovery. Motivated by this finding, we introduce tool-augmented on-policy distillation (TA-OPD), a post-training method to align sequence prediction with evidence-grounded biological reasoning. Across five Qwen3.5 models spanning 0.8B to 27B parameters, TA-OPD consistently strengthens biological evidence grounding while improving predictive performance on most tasks. These gains persist across model scales, indicating that stronger sequence reasoning does not arise solely from increased model capacity, but can be improved through evidence-aware training. Together, OmicsBench and TA-OPD provide a framework for diagnosing reasoning failures in multi-omics LLMs and a path toward models whose predictions are better grounded in biologically meaningful evidence.
items.summary_zh: OmicsBench 用 1,160 个专家验证问题评估多组学序列模型的证据链，TA-OPD 则通过工具增强的 on-policy distillation 改善模型的生物学证据支撑。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究发现分类准确率高的科学 LLM 仍可能无法给出有效生物学证据，并在 0.8B-27B 的五个 Qwen3.5 模型上显示证据感知训练可提升推理。
items.abstract_zh: 多组学序列包含复杂的生物学模式，但要让自动化科学发现系统解读其机制仍然具有挑战。当大型语言模型（LLM）解读这些序列时，同时评估预测和科学推理至关重要。然而，现有多组学序列任务基准依赖分类和回归指标，忽略了模型是否理解潜在的生物学证据。我们提出 OmicsBench，这是首个面向多组学序列的推理基准，包含跨越 DNA 调控、RNA 加工和蛋白质功能 6 个任务的 1,160 个专家验证问题。OmicsBench 要求可追溯的证据链，并使用领域专家制定的实例特异性评分标准进行评估。对 17 个 LLM 的评估显示，存在一种反向关系：尽管科学 LLM 在序列分类准确率上优于通用 LLM，但它们无法提供有效证据来支持预测。一种可能的解释是捷径学习：专门化模型可能依赖统计模式，而不是科学发现所需的生物学机制。受这一发现启发，我们提出 tool-augmented on-policy distillation（TA-OPD），这是一种用于使序列预测与基于证据的生物学推理对齐的后训练方法。在 5 个参数量从 0.8B 到 27B 的 Qwen3.5 模型上，TA-OPD 持续增强生物学证据支撑，并在大多数任务上改善预测性能。这些提升在不同模型规模上都保持存在，表明更强的序列推理并非仅来自模型容量增加，而是可以通过证据感知训练得到改善。总体而言，OmicsBench 和 TA-OPD 为诊断多组学 LLM 的推理失败提供了框架，并为构建预测更好地植根于有生物学意义证据的模型提供了路径。

items.abstract_zh: 来自 @DevenPzak 的 NanoGPT 新历史纪录为 39.9 秒（减少 27.7 秒），大幅刷新此前 67.6 秒的纪录！这一纪录为 NanoGPT 引入了一种新的思路：不去优化矩阵乘法，也不添加表达能力更强的运算，而是在单个 FLOP 层面进行极其巧妙的优化，并结合机器学习判断。如果某个 FLOP 在某一步中的价值很低，就跳过它。

items.title: @fchollet：I don't read/write code these days, I only instruct an LRM. But it's not because I think LRM code quality is perfect, or
items.abstract_or_text: I don't read/write code these days, I only instruct an LRM. But it's not because I think LRM code quality is perfect, or even good. And it's not because I think my instructions are always being perfectly acted upon -- I know they aren't. The thing is: LRMs don't just write your code, they unlock new ways to control what you're doing and maintain understanding of your system, which are about as effective as reading code. You can better test your codebase, you can audit specific components, you can spin up visualizations, you can ask the LRM to red team, etc. You can do all of these things at high speed -- you couldn't before. The benefits of reading/writing code can now be achieved in new ways. All in all, the ROI of writing code by hand is no longer looking good, not because LRMs got perfect but because they're so fast at doing things that you can develop new workflows around them, workflows that end up being more productive than the old workflows.
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 分享仅通过指导大语言推理模型来开发软件的新工作流观点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 作者认为模型虽然代码质量并不完美，却能通过测试、审计、可视化和红队分析带来新的系统控制方式；编辑判断这是重要的工程实践观点，但属于个人经验而非受控比较。
items.abstract_zh: 如今我不再阅读或编写代码，而只指导一个大语言推理模型。但这并不是因为我认为模型生成的代码质量完美，甚至不是因为它已经很好；我知道这些代码并不总是被完美执行。关键在于，大语言推理模型不只是编写代码，还解锁了控制工作和保持系统理解的新方式，其效果大致可以媲美阅读代码。你可以更好地测试代码库、审计特定组件、创建可视化、要求模型进行红队测试等。所有这些都能以很高的速度完成，而过去做不到。如今，通过新的方式也可以获得读写代码的收益。总的来说，手写代码的投资回报率已经不再理想；不是因为大语言推理模型变得完美，而是因为它们做事太快，让你能够围绕它们建立新的工作流，而这些工作流最终比旧工作流更高效。

items.title: Quantitative machine learning of protein interactions reveals the multiscale organization and molecular syntax of signaling networks
items.abstract_or_text: Cells employ dense networks of transient protein-protein interactions mediated by modular peptide-binding domains and unstructured peptidic motifs for high-fidelity information processing. How these networks physically execute computations through protein interactions governed by complex intra- and intermolecular mechanisms remains indiscernible from current, sparse and non-quantitative, maps of the human interactome. Here, we introduce a quantitative statistical mechanical modeling (QSM) approach for machine learning domain-peptide affinities with experimental-level accuracy. Leveraging a new, principled algorithm for data harmonization and a biophysically informed neural network architecture, QSM learns to predict dissociation constants directly from amino acid sequences with calibrated confidence. We use QSM to construct the first quantitative drafts of human signaling networks and study these networks across three physical scales--recognition mechanisms of modular binding domains, combinatorial logic of multi-dentate proteins, and pathways inferred from de novo inference of protein interaction networks. We find that (i) modular domains, based on their binding preferences, selectivities, and strengths, fall into a limited number of biophysical equivalence groups, (ii) those domains, along with peptidic motifs, are "syntactically" combined within proteins to yield multivalent recognition mechanisms, and (iii) the organization of cellular function can be traced back to algorithmically detectable modules induced by domain-mediated interactions. In aggregate, these analyses instantiate a tractable roadmap towards a comprehensive, mechanistic, and simulatable articulation of the systems biology of signaling.
items.summary_zh: 提出定量统计力学建模方法 QSM，用实验校准的神经网络从氨基酸序列预测 domain-peptide 解离常数，并构建多尺度人类信号网络草图。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把序列到亲和力预测与机制化信号网络建模连接起来，可用于研究模块化结合域、多价识别和通路组织。限制是模型和网络草图依赖数据协调及已有实验测量，网络推断的全面性和对新蛋白的外推仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞利用由模块化肽结合域和无序肽基序介导的密集瞬时蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络，以高保真度处理信息。由复杂的分子内和分子间机制控制的蛋白质相互作用如何在物理上执行计算，仍无法从当前稀疏且非定量的人类互作组图谱中辨明。在这里，我们提出定量统计力学建模（QSM）方法，用于以实验级准确度对 domain-peptide 亲和力进行机器学习。借助一种有原则的新数据协调算法和具有生物物理依据的神经网络架构，QSM 学会直接从氨基酸序列预测解离常数，并给出经过校准的置信度。我们使用 QSM 构建首批人类信号网络的定量草图，并在三个物理尺度上研究这些网络——模块化结合域的识别机制、多齿蛋白的组合逻辑，以及通过从头推断蛋白质相互作用网络得到的通路。我们发现：（i）模块化结构域根据其结合偏好、选择性和强度可归入数量有限的生物物理等价组；（ii）这些结构域与肽基序在蛋白质内以“句法”方式组合，形成多价识别机制；（iii）细胞功能的组织可以追溯到由结构域介导相互作用诱导、且可由算法检测的模块。总体而言，这些分析构成了一条可处理的路线图，旨在全面、机制化且可模拟地阐述信号系统生物学。
items.author_line: Rogers, J. R., Cardani, L. P., Shah, N. H., AlQuraishi, M.

items.title: Targeted finetuning enables co-folding models to learn ligand-induced protein conformational states
items.abstract_or_text: Advances in protein structure prediction have enabled all-atom protein-ligand co-folding models that predict bound conformations directly from sequence and small-molecule structure. However, these models often fail to generalize to novel binding sites or alternative protein conformational states, limiting their utility for chemical biology and drug discovery. Here we show this limitation reflects training data bias rather than architectural constraints and can be overcome through targeted finetuning. Using ten previously unseen X-ray structures of Werner (WRN) helicase from a drug discovery program, we finetune Boltz-1 to learn both an allosteric binding site and a large conformational change locking the enzyme in an inactive state, while preserving accuracy on the ATP-bound state. The finetuned model generalizes to different chemical series and transfers the conformational logic across RecQ-family helicases in a binding-site sequence-dependent manner. This approach provides a blueprint for adapting foundation models as new structural and mechanistic data emerge, enabling co-folding networks to capture ligand-induced conformational switches and binding poses absent from their training data but central to biological regulation and therapeutic intervention.
items.summary_zh: 对 Boltz-1 进行靶向微调，使其从十个此前未见的 WRN helicase X-ray 结构中学习配体诱导的变构结合位点和大尺度失活构象变化，并迁移到其他 RecQ-family helicases。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 说明 co-folding 模型的失败可由训练数据偏差而非架构限制造成，提供了用新增结构和机制数据适配基础模型的药物发现方案。限制是案例集中于 WRN 及 RecQ 家族，外推到其他蛋白家族仍需更多独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质结构预测的进展已经催生全原子蛋白质-配体 co-folding 模型，可直接从序列和小分子结构预测结合构象。然而，这些模型往往无法泛化到新的结合位点或蛋白质的替代构象状态，从而限制了其在化学生物学和药物发现中的用途。在这里，我们表明，这一限制反映的是训练数据偏差而非架构约束，并且可以通过靶向微调来克服。我们使用来自一个药物发现项目的 Werner（WRN）helicase 的十个此前未见的 X-ray 结构，对 Boltz-1 进行微调，使其同时学习一个变构结合位点和一个将酶锁定在失活状态的大尺度构象变化，同时保持对 ATP-bound 状态的准确性。微调后的模型可以泛化到不同的化学系列，并以依赖结合位点序列的方式，将构象逻辑迁移到其他 RecQ-family helicases。该方法为随着新的结构和机制数据出现而调整基础模型提供了蓝图，使 co-folding 网络能够捕获训练数据中不存在、但对生物调控和治疗干预至关重要的配体诱导构象开关和结合姿态。
items.author_line: Gorantla, R., Schleberger, C., Sesterhenn, F.

items.title: Rotamer-Dependent Amino Acid Descriptors as Protein and Peptide Representation for Reactivity and Property Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: We present RotADeL, a Rotamer-dependent Amino acid Descriptors Library designed to facilitate the use of chemically interpretable representations in machine learning models for peptide and protein reactivity. RotADeL contains precomputed steric and electronic descriptors for the rotamer ensembles of the canonical amino acids, accounting for their different protonation states. These descriptors can be queried either from a known protein structure, by selecting the closest library rotamer, or directly from an amino acid sequence, by averaging over the rotamer ensemble according to backbone and side-chain conformational probabilities. The latter approach avoids the need for computationally demanding protein geometry generation. We evaluated the resulting features in two case studies: first, the comparison of RotADeL descriptors to commonly used peptide representations for antimicrobial activity and toxicity classification; secondly, the application of RotADeL descriptors to predict the enantioselectivity of cyclisation reactions catalysed by GluER-T36A. Together, these results show that RotADeL provides a transferable and interpretable amino acid representation for machine learning predictions of peptide property and enzyme reactivity.
items.summary_zh: 发布 RotADeL 氨基酸描述符库，为标准氨基酸的 rotamer ensemble 预计算立体和电子描述符，并在抗菌肽活性/毒性分类及酶催化环化反应对映选择性预测中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了不必先生成完整蛋白几何结构、且具有化学可解释性的蛋白和肽表示，有助于连接序列、构象和反应性。限制是验证仅包含两个案例，描述符对非典型残基、复杂环境和更大数据集的迁移性尚待评估。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 RotADeL，一个依赖 rotamer 的氨基酸描述符库，旨在促进使用具有化学可解释性的表示来建立肽和蛋白质反应性的机器学习模型。RotADeL 包含标准氨基酸各个 rotamer ensemble 的预计算立体和电子描述符，并考虑它们不同的质子化状态。可以从已知的蛋白质结构中查询这些描述符，方法是选择最接近的库中 rotamer；也可以直接从氨基酸序列中查询，方法是根据主链和侧链构象概率对 rotamer ensemble 进行平均。后一种方法避免了计算成本高昂的蛋白质几何结构生成。我们在两个案例研究中评估这些特征：第一，将 RotADeL 描述符与常用肽表示比较，用于抗菌活性和毒性分类；第二，使用 RotADeL 描述符预测 GluER-T36A 催化环化反应的对映选择性。总体而言，这些结果表明，RotADeL 提供了一种可迁移且可解释的氨基酸表示，可用于肽性质和酶反应性的机器学习预测。
items.author_line: Lauriane Jacot-Descombes, Kjell Jorner

items.title: AnewDDE: An Agentic Drug Discovery Engine for Biomolecular Interaction Modelling and Closed-Loop Design
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate modelling of biomolecular interactions is fundamental to drug discovery, yet current artificial intelligence (AI) workflows remain fragmented across structure prediction, affinity estimation, molecular design, and experimental decision-making. We introduce AnewDDE, an agentic Drug Discovery Engine that connects these capabilities into a closed-loop system for biomolecular interaction modelling and design. We demonstrate several components of this system: AnewFold delivers superior performance on challenging targets, including antibody-antigen complexes and molecular glues, providing more reliable structural hypotheses together with pocket identification and conformational analysis; AnewDesign achieves a 10.7% success rate in identifying binders with single-digit-nanomolar affinities measured by surface plasmon resonance (SPR) in a representative nanobody discovery campaign, substantially reducing the experimental search burden; AnewAffinity combines accuracy approaching that of free-energy perturbation (FEP) methods with the speed required for high-throughput screening and prioritizes promising transformations; and AnewMind, a large language model (LLM) at the hundred-billion-parameter scale that underwent in-house full-parameter post-training, provides scientific reasoning and absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) prediction for pharmaceutical research and development (R&D). To systematically evaluate AnewMind, we introduce PharmBench, an internal benchmark designed by pharmaceutical R&D experts to evaluate long-horizon decision-making in drug discovery. Evaluations on ADMET tasks and PharmBench show that AnewMind performs competitively with leading frontier models. Together, these capabilities establish AnewDDE as an integrated engine for addressing challenging therapeutic targets and translating molecular insights into experimentally validated candidates at scale.
items.summary_zh: AnewDDE 将结构预测、亲和力估计、分子设计、LLM 推理和实验决策整合为闭环药物发现引擎，并在纳米抗体发现中报告 SPR 验证的结合体。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该系统覆盖从结构假设到实验验证的完整链路，报告了 10.7% 的单个位数纳摩尔结合体发现成功率，但其 PharmBench 为内部基准，外部可复现性仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 准确建模生物分子相互作用是药物发现的基础，但当前人工智能（AI）工作流在结构预测、亲和力估计、分子设计和实验决策之间仍然彼此割裂。我们介绍 AnewDDE，这是一种将这些能力连接起来、用于生物分子相互作用建模与设计的智能体式药物发现引擎。我们展示了该系统的多个组件：AnewFold 在包括抗体—抗原复合物和分子胶在内的困难靶点上取得更好的性能，提供更可靠的结构假设以及口袋识别和构象分析；AnewDesign 在一项具有代表性的纳米抗体发现活动中，通过表面等离子体共振（SPR）测得的单个位数纳摩尔亲和力结合体发现成功率为 10.7%，显著减少了实验搜索负担；AnewAffinity 以接近自由能微扰（FEP）方法的准确性和高通量筛选所需的速度相结合，并优先排序有前景的转化；AnewMind 是一个百亿参数规模的 large language model（LLM），经过内部全参数后训练，为药物研发（R&D）提供科学推理以及吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）预测。为系统评估 AnewMind，我们引入 PharmBench，这是由制药研发专家设计、用于评价药物发现中长期决策的内部基准。在 ADMET 任务和 PharmBench 评估中，AnewMind 的表现与领先前沿模型具有竞争力。总体而言，这些能力构成了一个综合引擎，用于应对困难治疗靶点，并在规模化条件下将分子洞见转化为经实验验证的候选物。
items.author_line: Liu K

items.title: HR-FRGS: A Novel Biomarker Discovery Protocol using Dual Layer Hypergraph Learning for NGS RNA Sequence Data
items.abstract_or_text: Biomarker discovery from high-dimensional RNA sequencing data remains challenging. Conventional methods such as differential expression analysis, pairwise protein-protein interaction networks, and weighted gene co-expression network analysis suffer from false-positive interactions, transitivity-driven noise, and arbitrary thresholds for feature selection. Addressing these limitations, this study proposed a novel framework, Hypergraph Regularised Fuzzy Rough Gene Selection (HR-FRGS), for knowledge-driven biomarker discovery. This pipeline integrates information-rich protein clustering with entropy filtering and PPI-pruned co-expression interactions to form a dual-layer hypergraph. A hypergraph-based scoring method that combines Random Walk with Restart diffusion and Hypergraph Betweenness Centrality is used to identify genes that are central in the biological network. Furthermore an autonomous fuzzy rough set selection eliminates arbitrary threshold dependency for gene selection. HR-FRGS was applied to four TCGA cancer cohorts: Lung Adenocarcinoma, Head and Neck Cancer, Kidney Clear Cell Carcinoma, and Colon Cancer, which reduced over 60,000 transcripts to compact biomarker panels. Validation using classical Machine Learning algorithms with cross-validation demonstrated that biomarker panels matched or exceeded the classification performance of the full transcriptome (AUC > 0.99, MCC > 0.94) and confirmed generalizability (MCC \geq 0.893). Benchmarking against baseline methods and an ablation study showed the contribution of major parts of the algorithm. Functional enrichment analysis captures established pan-cancer hallmarks and cohort-specific oncogenic mechanisms, confirming the biological relevance of the identified genes.
items.summary_zh: HR-FRGS 以双层超图、随机游走重启、超图介数中心性和模糊粗糙集，从四个 TCGA 癌症队列的 >60,000 个转录本中筛出紧凑生物标志物面板。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究报告 AUC >0.99、MCC >0.94 及外部泛化 MCC ≥0.893，并通过基线和消融分析评估组件贡献，但仍需注意队列与验证设置的限制。
items.abstract_zh: 从高维 RNA 测序数据中发现生物标志物仍然具有挑战性。差异表达分析、成对蛋白质—蛋白质相互作用网络和加权基因共表达网络分析等传统方法存在假阳性相互作用、由传递性驱动的噪声以及特征选择阈值任意等问题。为应对这些限制，本研究提出了用于知识驱动生物标志物发现的新框架 Hypergraph Regularised Fuzzy Rough Gene Selection（HR-FRGS）。该流程将包含丰富信息的蛋白质聚类与熵过滤、以及经过 PPI 剪枝的共表达相互作用整合，形成双层超图。基于超图的评分方法结合 Random Walk with Restart 扩散和 Hypergraph Betweenness Centrality，用于识别生物学网络中的中心基因。此外，自主模糊粗糙集选择消除了基因选择对任意阈值的依赖。HR-FRGS 应用于 4 个 TCGA 癌症队列：肺腺癌、头颈癌、肾透明细胞癌和结肠癌，将超过 60,000 个转录本缩减为紧凑的生物标志物面板。使用经典机器学习算法进行交叉验证表明，生物标志物面板的分类性能达到或超过完整转录组（AUC > 0.99，MCC > 0.94），并确认了其泛化能力（MCC ≥ 0.893）。与基线方法的比较和消融研究显示了主要算法组件的贡献。功能富集分析捕捉到了已确立的泛癌标志和队列特异性致癌机制，支持所识别基因的生物学相关性。
items.author_line: Gupta MK, Paul M, Pati SK

items.title: Machine Learning-Driven Identification of Therapeutic Checkpoints in Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Network-Based Approach to Discover Resolution- Promoting Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background: Current therapeutic strategies for Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) primarily focus on anti-inflammatory approaches, which often fail to induce sustained remission. Shifting the paradigm toward "Resolution Pharmacology" requires identifying therapeutic checkpoints within the synovial microenvironment capable of activating resolution-promoting pathways. Methods: We employed a systems biology and machine learning framework analyzing synovial transcriptomic data. Following differential gene expression (DEG) analysis, Reactome pathway enrichment was utilized to isolate resolution-specific networks. Machine learning algorithms, particularly Random Forest , were trained and externally validated to classify RA phenotypes. Furthermore, reverse signature analysis was applied to computationally repurpose drugs capable of reverting the pathological transcriptomic profile. To facilitate clinical translation, an interactive web-based dashboard was developed for real-time data exploration. Results: Analysis identified 2,135 DEGs (1,168 upregulated, 967 downregulated) significantly discriminating RA patients from healthy controls. The machine learning model achieved a high classification accuracy of 86.96% on the validation dataset ( GSE77298 ). Protein-protein interaction network analysis pinpointed critical therapeutic checkpoints, prominently including MYC, PTPRC, and JUN . Computational drug repurposing revealed Manumycin A and Salermide as the top candidate resolution-promoting agents capable of reversing the RA transcriptomic signature. Conclusion: This study provides a validated machine learning pipeline identifying novel therapeutic checkpoints and repurposable drugs to promote inflammation resolution in RA. The integration of these findings into an open-source interactive dashboard offers a scalable tool to accelerate drug discovery and precision medicine in autoimmune diseases.
items.summary_zh: 该研究用滑膜转录组、网络分析、随机森林和反向签名药物重定位识别 RA 的潜在 resolution checkpoints，并提出 Manumycin A 和 Salermide。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提供了外部验证（GSE77298，准确率 86.96%）和开放交互式仪表板，但药物候选仍是计算推断，不能视为临床疗效或因果验证。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：当前类风湿关节炎（RA）的治疗策略主要聚焦于抗炎，但往往无法诱导持久缓解。改变范式、转向“Resolution Pharmacology”需要识别滑膜微环境中能够激活促消退通路的治疗检查点。方法：我们采用系统生物学和机器学习框架分析滑膜转录组数据。在差异基因表达（DEG）分析之后，使用 Reactome 通路富集来筛选与消退相关的特异性网络。使用机器学习算法，尤其是 Random Forest，训练并外部验证用于 RA 表型分类的模型。此外，应用反向签名分析，计算上重定位能够逆转病理性转录组特征的药物。为促进临床转化，我们开发了交互式网页仪表板，用于实时数据探索。结果：分析识别出 2,135 个能够显著区分 RA 患者与健康对照者的 DEG（1,168 个上调，967 个下调）。机器学习模型在验证数据集（GSE77298）上的分类准确率为 86.96%。蛋白质—蛋白质相互作用网络分析锁定了关键治疗检查点，尤其包括 MYC、PTPRC 和 JUN。计算药物重定位显示，Manumycin A 和 Salermide 是最有潜力的促消退候选药物，能够逆转 RA 转录组特征。结论：本研究提供了一个经验证的机器学习流程，用于识别可促进炎症消退的新治疗检查点和可重定位药物。将这些发现整合到开放源代码交互式仪表板中，可为加速自身免疫疾病的药物发现和精准医学提供可扩展工具。
items.author_line: Fathinejad A

items.title: Self-Play Search Distillation for Large Language Model Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Improving reasoning abilities in Large Language Models (LLMs) requires high-quality data that exposes difficult decisions, competing alternatives, and their consequences. Data scarcity is driven by the low quality of synthetic data and the cost of human labeling. We introduce Self-Play Search Distillation (SPSD), a framework for generating superhuman synthetic data via self-play of MuZero-like networks trained on board games. SPSD uses executable environments to turn search into structured reasoning problems. At each state, the expert identifies a preferred decision, plausible alternatives, plausible opponent replies, and value estimates. By converting the self-play search records into superhuman chains-of-thought, we train LLMs with environment-grounded supervision. Although trained only on self-play search records, SPSD transfers to unseen mathematics. On Qwen3-4B-Base, it raises the mean over six mathematics benchmarks from 24.1 to 36.6 while increasing the held-out-game win rate from 15% to 45%. SPSD offers an annotation-efficient way to create high-quality synthetic data for improving LLM performance in reasoning tasks.
items.summary_zh: SPSD 使用 MuZero 式自博弈搜索记录生成包含决策、备选方案、对手回应和价值估计的合成推理数据，再用于训练语言模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在只用棋类自博弈记录训练的情况下，Qwen3-4B-Base 在 6 个数学基准上的均值从 24.1 提升到 36.6，并报告留出棋局胜率变化。
items.abstract_zh: 提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力需要高质量数据，使模型接触困难决策、相互竞争的备选方案及其后果。合成数据质量低和人工标注成本高，造成了数据稀缺。我们提出 Self-Play Search Distillation（SPSD），一种通过在棋类游戏中训练的 MuZero 式网络进行自博弈来生成超人类合成数据的框架。SPSD 使用可执行环境把搜索转化为结构化推理问题。在每个状态，专家识别首选决策、合理的备选方案、合理的对手回应和价值估计。我们将自博弈搜索记录转换为超人类思维链，并用环境提供的监督训练 LLM。尽管训练只使用自博弈搜索记录，SPSD 仍能迁移到未见过的数学任务。在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上，它将 6 个数学基准的均值从 24.1 提升到 36.6，同时将留出棋局胜率从 15% 提升到 45%。SPSD 提供了一种节省标注的方法，可以生成高质量合成数据以改进 LLM 的推理任务表现。
items.author_line: Lorenzo Molfetta, Wai-Chung Kwan, Giacomo Frisoni, Luca Ragazzi, Gianluca Moro, Pavlos Vougiouklis, Jeff Z. Pan, Pasquale Minervini

items.title: PFArena: Benchmarking Language Models for Protein Modification
items.abstract_or_text: Protein modification requires navigating an immense sequence space, yet wet-lab validation remains low-throughput and costly. Although computational paradigms including protein language models (PLMs), large language models (LLMs), and LLM-based agents have shown promise in protein modification, their relative efficacy across realistic experimental decision-making settings remains unclear. To bridge this gap, we introduce PFArena, a benchmark comprising four controlled task interfaces that cover single-mutant generation and multi-mutant ranking. By providing varying levels of mutation fitness data, PFArena reflects four representative research scenarios characterized by differing degrees of prior experimental context. We assess six PLMs, six LLMs, and five LLM-based agents using complementary metrics to measure both peak and overall protein modification performance. Our evaluation reveals that model performance shifts systematically with the availability of target-specific experimental evidence: PLMs demonstrate proficiency in open-ended single-mutant generation by leveraging protein-specific priors, whereas LLMs and agents perform strongly in multi-mutant ranking, particularly when target-specific fitness data are available. Nevertheless, all model families face fundamental challenges with increasing search-space size and mutation depth. We release our code and benchmark suite to facilitate reproducible research in model-assisted protein modification.
items.summary_zh: 构建 PFArena 蛋白质改造基准，覆盖单突变生成和多突变排序四类受控任务，系统比较6个 PLM、6个 LLM 和5个 LLM agent 在不同实验信息量下的表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 明确展示了模型家族与可用靶点实验数据之间的任务依赖关系，为蛋白质工程模型选择和可复现实验决策评测提供了基线。限制是基准任务仍是受控接口，不能完全反映真实湿实验中的表达、纯化和测定噪声。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质改造需要在巨大的序列空间中进行搜索，而湿实验验证的通量低且成本高。尽管包括蛋白质语言模型（PLM）、大语言模型（LLM）和基于 LLM 的 agent 在内的计算范式已显示出蛋白质改造潜力，但它们在真实实验决策场景中的相对有效性仍不清楚。为此，我们提出 PFArena，一个包含四种受控任务接口的基准，覆盖单突变生成和多突变排序。通过提供不同程度的突变适应度数据，PFArena 反映了四种具有不同先验实验背景的代表性研究场景。我们使用互补指标评估6个 PLM、6个 LLM 和5个基于 LLM 的 agent，以衡量蛋白质改造的峰值性能和整体性能。评估显示，随着靶点特异性实验依据的可用性发生变化，不同模型的表现会系统性改变：PLM 利用蛋白质特异性先验，在开放式单突变生成中表现出色；LLM 和 agent 在多突变排序中表现较强，尤其是在具有靶点特异性适应度数据时。然而，随着搜索空间扩大和突变深度增加，所有模型家族都面临根本性挑战。我们发布代码和基准套件，以促进模型辅助蛋白质改造研究的可复现性。
items.author_line: Yawen Ouyang, Xinbo Zhang, Ziyuan Ma, Yixin Wu, Wenbin Liao, Feiran Zhang, Wenjie Li, Lihao Wang, Hao Wang, Xiaoqing Zheng, Xuefeng Yan, Lei Bai, Ya-Qin Zhang, Shuyi Zhang, Wei-Ying Ma, Dahua Lin, Bowen Zhou, Hao Zhou

items.title: Cell-Lens: Advancing LLM Reasoning at Single-Cell Resolution
items.abstract_or_text: Recent work applies large language models (LLMs) to single-cell data, but the cell usually reaches the model as a short ranked list of genes. This list drops much of what defines a cell, so the model reasons from a partial view. Yet the information is not lost in the measurement, only in the text. Here, we introduce Cell-Lens, a training-free structured representation of the measured cell. It writes the cell as typed blocks, from paired measurements to marker-supported programs. On CellVerse, SOAR, CellPuzzles, and SC-Arena, across five model families, Cell-Lens improves performance by up to 27.1 points. It also narrows the model gap and reduces API-reported reasoning-token usage. The largest gains occur when a defining RNA marker falls out of the ranked list. In these cases, the paired protein data still capture the corresponding signal. Shuffling the added blocks removes the gain. The gain persists after selected label-associated proteins are removed. These controls link the improvement to cell-matched biological content. We also build and release CellSpectrum, a broader benchmark spanning eight sources and seven tasks with paired modalities. The gains hold there across tasks, tissues, and modalities. These results show that a better cell representation can improve single-cell reasoning without retraining the model. Code and CellSpectrum are publicly available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Cell-Lens.
items.summary_zh: Cell-Lens 通过无需训练的结构化细胞表示，将配对测量和标志物支持的程序提供给 LLM，在多模型、多数据集单细胞基准上最多提升 27.1 points，并发布 CellSpectrum。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究用置乱和去除标签相关蛋白等对照支持性能提升来自匹配的生物学内容，而非简单增加文本，并提供公开代码和多模态基准。
items.abstract_zh: 近期工作将大型语言模型（LLM）应用于单细胞数据，但细胞通常以一份简短的基因排序列表输入模型。这份列表丢失了许多定义细胞的内容，因此模型只能基于不完整的视图进行推理。然而，这些信息并没有在测量时丢失，而是在转写成文本时丢失。我们提出 Cell-Lens，这是一种无需训练的已测量细胞结构化表示。它将细胞写成带类型的区块，从配对测量到由标志物支持的程序。在 CellVerse、SOAR、CellPuzzles 和 SC-Arena 上，跨 5 个模型系列，Cell-Lens 最多将性能提高 27.1 points。它还缩小了模型之间的差距，并减少了 API 报告的推理 token 使用量。当定义性 RNA 标志物从排序列表中脱落时，性能提升最大。在这些情况下，配对的蛋白质数据仍然捕捉到相应信号。打乱新增区块会消除这一提升。在移除选定的标签相关蛋白后，这一提升仍然存在。这些对照将性能改进与匹配细胞的生物学内容联系起来。我们还构建并发布了 CellSpectrum，这是一个更广泛的基准，覆盖 8 个来源和 7 个具有配对模态的任务。在不同任务、组织和模态中，性能提升仍然成立。这些结果表明，更好的细胞表示无需重新训练模型即可改善单细胞推理。代码和 CellSpectrum 已公开发布于 https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Cell-Lens。
items.author_line: li y, Gao B, Liu W, Xie J, Tsui TY, Zhang Y, Wang Y, Fu T, Li Y

items.title: Topology-Stratified Materials Discovery with A Flow-Based Generative Model
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate generation of crystal structures is the foundation to the discovery of high-performance materials for extreme-environment applications, such as aerospace, additive manufacturing, and fusion energy systems. Although generative modeling has emerged as a promising approach for crystal design, its performance remains limited by the complex crystal structures and diverse chemical compositions. In this work, we develop UFO-MGen, a universal flow-based generative model that learns topological features of Wyckoff representations and leverages this information to accurately generate crystals across vast structural and chemical spaces. Compared with state-of-the-art generative models, UFO-MGen achieves the highest crystal generation success rate under a rigorous multi-stability evaluation framework, the highest SUN (stable, unique, novel) rate, and a remarkable extrapolation capability that has not been reported by previous models. Furthermore, a fine-tuning module is implemented to UFO-MGen for property-constrained crystal generation, enabling the inverse materials design toward target properties. The UFO-MGen opens a new avenue for accelerated materials discovery and providing a foundation for universal materials intelligence.
items.summary_zh: 开发 UFO-MGen 通用流模型，学习 Wyckoff 表示的拓扑特征以生成晶体结构，并通过微调实现面向目标性质的约束晶体生成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将拓扑信息显式纳入材料生成，报告了多稳定性评估下的生成成功率、SUN 率和外推能力，并支持性质约束的逆向材料设计。限制是摘要未给出具体结构数量、实验合成或性质测量验证，性能结论主要来自计算基准。
items.abstract_zh: 准确生成晶体结构是发现适用于航空航天、增材制造和聚变能源等极端环境的高性能材料的基础。尽管生成模型已成为晶体设计中很有前景的方法，但其性能仍受复杂晶体结构和多样化学组成限制。在本工作中，我们开发 UFO-MGen，一个通用流模型，学习 Wyckoff 表示的拓扑特征，并利用这些信息在广泛的结构和化学空间中准确生成晶体。与当前最先进的生成模型相比，UFO-MGen 在严格的多稳定性评估框架下取得最高的晶体生成成功率、最高的 SUN（稳定、唯一、新颖）率，以及此前模型未曾报告的显著外推能力。此外，我们为 UFO-MGen 实现了一个微调模块，用于受性质约束的晶体生成，从而实现面向目标性质的逆向材料设计。UFO-MGen 为加速材料发现开辟了新途径，并为通用材料智能提供了基础。
items.author_line: Jingyi Zhou, Oyshee Chowdhury, Noah Oyeniran, Chongze Hu

items.title: SLED-IFV: Solver-Validated LLM-Guided Decomposition for Scalable Hardware Information-Flow Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Formal hardware information-flow verification (IFV) provides strong guarantees against secret-dependent timing and control behavior, but often scales poorly on realistic RTL. We identify two recurring proof barriers in self-composed IFV: implementation complexity, where proof-hard datapath logic dominates even though the property needs only a compact boundary relation, and relational inductive complexity, where the proof depends on cross-copy public-control facts that the backend prover does not infer efficiently. To address them, we introduce two semantic proof decomposition forms: functional simplification, which replaces a proof-hard RTL region with a validated over-approximate summary, and relational strengthening, which exposes and proves the cross-copy relations needed for induction. We further present SLED-IFV, a solver-validated LLM-guided flow that automates the selection of these forms and their concrete targets. Given a self-composed miter and an oracle-free decision sheet, the LLM proposes a decomposition, then materializes it into proof artifacts under controller checks. The controller compiles the checked artifacts into proof obligations, and the formal verification backend remains the sole authority for acceptance. Across nine nontrivial benchmarks constructed from real RTL, SLED-IFV achieves up to 603x solver-only speedup and converts two 12-hour timeouts into completed proofs. The closed-loop flow produces verifier-accepted decompositions for all cases.
items.summary_zh: SLED-IFV 让语言模型提出硬件信息流验证的语义分解，再由控制器和形式化后端检查并接受这些证明工件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 9 个真实 RTL 基准上，最高获得 603 倍求解器加速，并将两个 12 小时超时转化为完成的证明；所有案例均产生了验证器接受的分解。
items.abstract_zh: 形式化硬件信息流验证（IFV）能够为依赖秘密的时序和控制行为提供强保证，但在真实 RTL 上通常难以扩展。我们识别出自组合 IFV 中反复出现的两类证明障碍：其一是实现复杂度，即使性质只需要紧凑的边界关系，证明困难的数据通路逻辑仍占据主要部分；其二是关系归纳复杂度，即证明依赖跨副本的公共控制事实，而后端证明器难以高效推断这些事实。为此，我们引入两种语义证明分解形式：功能简化，用经过验证的过近似摘要替换证明困难的 RTL 区域；关系强化，显式揭示并证明归纳所需的跨副本关系。我们进一步提出 SLED-IFV，这是一种由语言模型引导、由求解器验证的流程，可自动选择这些形式及其具体目标。给定一个自组合 miter 和一份无需预言机的决策表，语言模型提出分解方案，然后在控制器检查下将其具体化为证明工件。控制器把经过检查的工件编译为证明义务，而形式化验证后端仍是唯一的接受权威。在由真实 RTL 构造的 9 个非平凡基准上，SLED-IFV 最高实现了相对于仅使用求解器的流程 603 倍加速，并将两个 12 小时超时转化为已完成证明。闭环流程在所有案例中都产生了验证器接受的分解。
items.author_line: Liangtao Dai, Yimin Gao, Melika Morsali, Mircea Stan

items.title: Math Reasoning in LLMs is Organized by Approach, Not Topic
items.abstract_or_text: Mathematical reasoning benchmarks are typically organized by topic, but language models may organize their internal computation by reusable reasoning approach instead. In this paper, we investigate whether open math-capable LLMs organize internally by topical sub-skill or by reasoning approach, and we present evidence that the approach is the key. We introduce a generation-replay protocol: a model first generates a solution, after which we replay the exact prompt-plus-generation trajectory and extract activation-importance signatures over the reasoning tokens. We cluster these signatures without supervision across eight models and five mathematical reasoning sources, then evaluate the recovered structure with structural, semantic, and intervention tests. Across all 40 model-source cells, the recovered clusters outperform matched-size random baselines. Two independent frontier-LLM judges find approach-level coherence in 77-82% of real clusters versus 6-11% in within-source controls, and topic-pure clusters usually receive labels finer than the topic itself. In approach-controlled prompting, changing the requested reasoning approach shifts cluster assignment in seven of eight model conditions, whereas paraphrases largely preserve it. These results indicate that math-capable LLMs organize internal mathematical computation by reasoning approach rather than benchmark topic. The implication is that topic-stratified benchmarks and topic-balanced training corpora can still miss the axis that matters: even deliberately topic-balanced corpora may remain imbalanced over reasoning approaches.
items.summary_zh: 研究通过生成-回放协议和激活重要性聚类，考察数学模型内部计算更接近按“推理方法”还是按“题目主题”组织。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨 8 个模型和 5 个数学来源的结构、语义与干预测试，提示按主题划分的基准可能遗漏推理方法这一关键轴；结论仍是内部表征分析而非定理证明。
items.abstract_zh: 数学推理基准通常按主题组织，但语言模型可能反而按可复用的推理方法组织其内部计算。在本文中，我们研究开放的数学能力大型语言模型在内部是按主题子技能还是按推理方法组织的，并给出证据表明方法是关键。我们提出一种生成-回放协议：模型先生成一个解答，随后我们重放精确的提示加生成轨迹，并提取推理词元上的激活重要性特征。我们在 8 个模型和 5 个数学推理来源上无监督地聚类这些特征，然后通过结构、语义和干预测试评估所恢复的结构。在全部 40 个模型-来源单元中，所恢复的聚类都优于匹配规模的随机基线。两位相互独立的前沿大型语言模型评审者发现，真实聚类中有 77–82% 具有方法层面的连贯性，而同来源控制组只有 6–11%；主题纯聚类通常会获得比主题本身更细的标签。在控制推理方法的提示实验中，改变要求的推理方法会在 8 个模型条件中的 7 个改变聚类分配，而改写措辞大体保持原有分配。这些结果表明，具备数学能力的 LLM 可能按推理方法而非基准主题组织内部数学计算。其含义是，按主题分层的基准和按主题平衡的训练语料仍可能遗漏真正重要的轴：即使刻意平衡主题的语料，在推理方法上也可能仍然不平衡。
items.author_line: Sajad Goudarzi, Samaneh Zamanifard, Moloud Nasiri, Hamed Rahimian

items.title: Flash-dLLM: IO-Aware KV Caching and Parallel Decoding for Fast, Memory-Efficient Diffusion LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs by enabling non-autoregressive text generation. However, their practical deployment remains limited by inefficient inference, largely due to the absence of effective Key-Value (KV) caching and scalable parallel decoding mechanisms. Existing acceleration methods typically study KV caching and parallel decoding in isolation, overlooking the I/O bottlenecks that arise when cache reuse and parallel token verification are jointly applied. In this work, we introduce Flash-dLLM, a training-free inference acceleration framework for fast and memory-efficient dLLMs. Flash-dLLM first identifies GPU memory I/O as a dominant bottleneck in KV-cache-enabled dLLM inference and addresses it with an I/O-aware fused KV-cache kernel that reduces redundant memory movement. Building on this optimized cache mechanism, Flash-dLLM further proposes an efficient KV-cache-driven draft-and-verify decoding strategy, where the dLLM itself serves as both drafter and verifier without requiring an auxiliary model. This unified design enables faster decoding while preserving generation quality and improving scalability to longer sequences and larger batch size. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks demonstrate that Flash-dLLM consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art dLLM acceleration methods in both inference speed and memory efficiency. In particular, it achieves 5.1\times and 11.0\times speedups over prior strongest baseline Elastic-Cache on GSM8K and HumanEval, respectively.
items.summary_zh: Flash-dLLM 通过融合 KV-cache 内核和由同一 dLLM 承担草稿与验证的并行解码，降低扩散语言模型推理中的 I/O 和内存开销。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 GSM8K 和 HumanEval 上相对 Elastic-Cache 报告 5.1 倍和 11.0 倍加速，并同时考察生成质量、速度和内存效率。
items.abstract_zh: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLM）通过支持非自回归文本生成，近来成为自回归 LLM 的一种有前景替代方案。然而，由于缺少有效的键值（KV）缓存和可扩展的并行解码机制，其实际部署仍受到低效推理的限制。现有加速方法通常将 KV 缓存与并行解码分开研究，忽视了缓存复用和并行词元验证共同使用时产生的 I/O 瓶颈。在本文中，我们提出 Flash-dLLM，一种无需训练的推理加速框架，用于快速且节省内存的 dLLM。Flash-dLLM 首先识别出 GPU 内存 I/O 是启用 KV 缓存的 dLLM 推理中的主要瓶颈，并通过一种具有 I/O 感知能力的融合 KV-cache 内核减少冗余内存移动。在此优化的缓存机制基础上，Flash-dLLM 进一步提出一种高效的、由 KV-cache 驱动的草稿-验证解码策略，其中 dLLM 自身同时充当草稿模型和验证模型，无需辅助模型。这种统一设计在保持生成质量的同时实现更快解码，并提升对更长序列和更大批量的可扩展性。在数学推理和代码生成基准上的大量实验表明，Flash-dLLM 在推理速度和内存效率方面持续优于现有先进 dLLM 加速方法。具体而言，相对于此前最强基线 Elastic-Cache，它在 GSM8K 和 HumanEval 上分别实现 5.1 倍和 11.0 倍加速。
items.author_line: Quan Nguyen-Tri, Mukul Ranjan, Zhiqiang Shen

items.title: Beyond Repeated Sampling: Learning Search Policies for LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models increasingly tackle hard reasoning problems by spending more test-time compute, yet the dominant strategy remains naive repeated sampling: draw many independent solutions and hope one is correct. Because such sampling explores only through local decoding noise, it tends to produce many near duplicate attempts rather than genuinely different ideas. We ask whether exploration can instead be steered at a semantic level, by first sampling problem specific concepts, hints, or strategies and then conditioning answer generation on them. We refine this into a simple, more exploratory procedure that emits many diverse concepts in a single trajectory, and evaluate it on hard problems where repeated sampling struggles. We then go a step further and make concept generation trainable: a small concept generator is optimized with reinforcement learning so that its concepts maximize the downstream success of a larger, frozen answer generator. On hard mathematical reasoning problems, the trained concept generator substantially improves the answer generator's pass@k over naive repeated sampling at the same answer generation allocation, surpasses concepts drawn from much larger untuned models, and transfers to answer generators it was never trained against, including a model from a different family. A small model can thus be trained into an effective, reusable search policy for a much larger one.
items.summary_zh: 该工作训练一个小型概念生成器，以语义层面的概念、提示和策略引导大型冻结答案生成器探索数学解法，比较同等生成预算下的 pass@k。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 实验显示训练后的搜索策略优于朴素重复采样，并能迁移到未参与训练的另一模型家族，直接检验了搜索多样性和跨模型泛化。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地通过增加测试时计算来处理困难推理问题，但主流策略仍是朴素的重复采样：独立抽取许多解答，并希望其中一个正确。由于这种采样只通过局部解码噪声进行探索，它往往产生许多近乎重复的尝试，而不是真正不同的想法。我们提出一个问题：能否先采样与问题相关的概念、提示或策略，再以此为条件生成答案，从而在语义层面引导探索？我们将这一想法细化为一种更具探索性的过程，在单条轨迹中生成许多不同概念，并在重复采样难以处理的困难问题上进行评估。进一步地，我们使概念生成可训练：用强化学习优化一个小型概念生成器，使其生成的概念在下游最大化大型冻结答案生成器的成功率。在困难数学推理问题上，在相同答案生成预算下，训练后的概念生成器显著提升了答案生成器的 pass@k，超过了从大得多但未经调优的模型中抽取的概念；它还可以迁移到未参与训练的答案生成器，包括来自不同模型家族的模型。因此，小模型可以被训练成大型模型的有效、可复用搜索策略。
items.author_line: Ismail Labiad, Matthieu Kowalski, Marc Schoenauer, Rémi Munos, Julia Kempe

items.title: GDN Tree-Scan: Served Tree Verification for Recurrent-Hybrid Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Tree speculative decoding verifies multiple candidate continuations in one target forward pass. For attention-only transformers, the verifier mainly needs an ancestry mask. Recurrent-hybrid language models break this assumption: a candidate row must also carry the recurrent state that native sequential decode would have produced along its root-to-node path. Otherwise, a verifier can use a correct attention mask while still conditioning on an impossible recurrent history. We present GDN Tree-Scan, a served verifier for Gated-DeltaNet hybrid language models integrated into vLLM. The system combines FlashAttention-2 tree-bias attention, branch-local GDN scan/replay, device-side multidraft commitment, and accepted-chain-only state publication. On the public Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 checkpoint, in a clean batch-one (B=1) SWE/Codex decode gate at temperature 0.6, a six-node root-branch tree increases committed tokens/event by 17.2% at near-native verify-forward time and reaches 23.88 token-weighted decode tokens/s versus 18.80 for native five-step MTP (E5), a 27.0% token-weighted decode-throughput gain. The per-request-equal latency view is +4.0%, and end-to-end task wall time remains prefill-heavy. Empirical equivalence evidence is scoped to recurrent-oracle probability-rescore (p-rescore) closure within the observed native flip floor, not a full distribution-distance proof.
items.summary_zh: GDN Tree-Scan 为循环-混合语言模型实现树式推测解码验证，在分支验证时重放局部循环状态，并只发布已接受链上的状态。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 公开 Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 检查点上报告 27.0% 的令牌加权解码吞吐提升，同时明确限定了等价性证据的适用范围。
items.abstract_zh: 树式推测解码可以在一次目标前向传播中验证多个候选延续。对于仅含注意力的 Transformer，验证器主要需要祖先掩码。循环-混合语言模型打破了这一假设：候选行还必须携带原生顺序解码沿其根到节点路径产生的循环状态。否则，即便验证器使用了正确的注意力掩码，它仍可能基于不可能的循环历史进行条件化。我们提出 GDN Tree-Scan，这是一种集成到 vLLM 中、面向 Gated-DeltaNet 混合语言模型的服务化验证器。系统结合了 FlashAttention-2 树偏置注意力、分支局部 GDN 扫描/重放、设备端多草稿提交以及仅接受链上的状态发布。在公开的 Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 检查点上，在温度为 0.6 的干净批量为 1（B=1）SWE/Codex 解码门控测试中，一个六节点根分支树将每次事件提交的词元数提高了 17.2%，验证前向时间接近原生水平，并达到每秒 23.88 个词元的词元加权解码速度，而原生五步 MTP（E5）为每秒 18.80 个词元，词元加权解码吞吐提升 27.0%。按每请求相等的延迟视角看，提升为 4.0%，而端到端任务耗时仍主要由预填充阶段决定。经验等价性证据的范围限于观测到的原生翻转下限内的循环预言机概率重评分（p-rescore）闭合，并非完整的分布距离证明。

items.title: Target-Specific De Novo Drug Design via Fine-Tuned Language Models and Molecular Docking, Molecular Dynamics Simulation Validation
items.abstract_or_text: De novo drug design remains an expensive and low-yield process, particularly for targets with limited bioactivity data. In this study, we fine-tuned the Qwen 2.5 0.5B model to treat ligand design as a sequence-to-sequence task from protein amino acid sequences to molecular SELFIES representations. A curated and balanced dataset derived from ChEMBL was used to reduce target-level data imbalance, followed by systematic evaluation using beam search and stochastic sampling. The fine-tuned model demonstrated strong ligand generation capability across multiple targets, achieving high validity, uniqueness, and novelty. Comparative analysis revealed that beam search favored conservative exploitation of learned chemical space, whereas sampling enabled broader exploration and higher novelty. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and MM/PBSA binding free-energy calculations for representative targets showed that generated compounds formed stable complexes with energetically favorable binding profiles comparable to known inhibitors. Notably, target-specific fine-tuning under extreme low data conditions, enabled through molecular representation augmentation, successfully guided ligand generation toward relevant structural frameworks. Our work suggests that small language models can be effectively fine-tuned for structure-aware, target-specific ligand design, even under limited bioactivity information.
items.summary_zh: 将 Qwen 2.5 0.5B 微调为从蛋白质氨基酸序列生成分子 SELFIES，并结合束搜索、随机采样、分子对接、分子动力学和 MM/PBSA 对代表性化合物进行验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了小型语言模型在极低生物活性数据条件下进行靶点特异性从头配体设计的可行路径，并比较了利用与探索的采样权衡。限制是对接、分子动力学和 MM/PBSA 仍主要是计算证据，尚未等同于实测活性。
items.abstract_zh: 从头药物设计仍然昂贵且产出率低，尤其是对于生物活性数据有限的靶点。在本研究中，我们对 Qwen 2.5 0.5B 模型进行微调，将配体设计视为从蛋白质氨基酸序列到分子 SELFIES 表示的序列到序列任务。我们使用源自 ChEMBL 的整理和平衡数据集来减少靶点层面的数据不平衡，随后通过束搜索和随机采样进行系统评估。微调模型在多个靶点上表现出较强的配体生成能力，具有较高的有效性、唯一性和新颖性。比较分析显示，束搜索倾向于保守地利用已学习的化学空间，而采样能够实现更广泛的探索并获得更高的新颖性。对接、分子动力学模拟和 MM/PBSA 结合自由能计算表明，对于代表性靶点，生成的化合物形成了稳定复合物，并呈现出与已知抑制剂相当的有利能量结合特征。值得注意的是，通过分子表示增强，在极低数据条件下进行靶点特异性微调，仍能引导配体生成走向相关的结构骨架。我们的工作表明，即使生物活性信息有限，小型语言模型也可以有效地进行结构感知、靶点特异性的配体设计。
items.author_line: Phuong Nguyen

items.title: RNASeek: A Cross-Phyla Generative Foundation Model for Multipurpose RNA Modeling and Reinforcement Learning-Based Design
items.abstract_or_text: RNA plays central roles in regulating information flow and provides a versatile substrate for engineering biological functions. While large language models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing and protein design, a general framework connecting RNA foundation models to functional sequence design remains limited. Here, we present RNASeek, a 1.6-billion-parameter generative foundation model built on a DeepSeek architecture and trained on a cross-phyla transcriptomic corpus for RNA sequence representation and generation. Natural-language tokens enable flexible conditional prediction and sequence design using a unified backbone. RNASeek captures species-specific transcript features and intron-exon boundaries in a zero-shot setting. We then fine-tune RNASeek to predict ribozyme self-cleavage activity and viral mRNA stability, revealing interpretable sequence features associated with function, including ribozyme loop flexibility and stem stability, as well as AU-rich motifs associated with mRNA stability. We use these functional predictors as reward models and apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to update the generation policy of RNASeek toward sequences with desired properties. GRPO-guided generation produces faster-cleaving ribozymes and stability-enhancing 3' UTRs while satisfying user-specified IUPAC constraints. Experimentally validated RNASeek-generated ribozymes achieve wild-type levels of activity, while RNASeek-generated 3' UTR sequences exceed the performance of the training data and benchmarked AI-generated 3' UTRs. Together, RNASeek establishes a unified pretrain-predict-optimize framework that connects learned RNA function to controllable de novo sequence design and provides a general strategy for engineering regulatory RNAs with desired properties.
items.summary_zh: 提出1.6-billion-parameter 的 RNASeek 生成式基础模型，在跨物种转录组上预训练，并通过功能预测器和 GRPO 强化学习设计具有目标核酶自切活性和 mRNA 稳定性的 RNA 序列。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把 RNA 表征、功能预测和可控序列生成统一到同一框架，并报告了核酶和3' UTR 的实验验证。限制是验证任务和序列类型仍较集中，跨功能、跨物种和体内表现需要进一步确认。
items.abstract_zh: RNA 在信息流调控中发挥核心作用，也是工程化生物功能的多用途基底。尽管大语言模型（LLM）已经改变了自然语言处理和蛋白质设计，但将 RNA 基础模型与功能序列设计连接起来的通用框架仍然有限。在这里，我们提出 RNASeek，一个基于 DeepSeek 架构、具有1.6-billion-parameter 的生成式基础模型；它在跨物种转录组语料上训练，用于 RNA 序列表示和生成。自然语言 token 支持使用统一骨干网络进行灵活的条件预测和序列设计。RNASeek 在零样本设置下捕获物种特异的转录本特征以及内含子-外显子边界。随后我们对 RNASeek 进行微调，以预测核酶自切活性和病毒 mRNA 稳定性，并揭示与功能相关且可解释的序列特征，包括核酶环的柔性、茎的稳定性，以及与 mRNA 稳定性相关的 AU-rich motifs。我们把这些功能预测器用作奖励模型，并应用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）更新 RNASeek 的生成策略，使生成序列趋向目标性质。在满足用户指定 IUPAC 约束的同时，GRPO 引导的生成产生了切割更快的核酶和增强稳定性的 3' UTR。实验验证的 RNASeek 生成核酶达到野生型水平的活性，而 RNASeek 生成的 3' UTR 序列性能超过训练数据和作为基准的 AI 生成 3' UTR。总体而言，RNASeek 建立了一个统一的预训练-预测-优化框架，将学习到的 RNA 功能与可控的从头序列设计连接起来，并为工程化具有目标性质的调控 RNA 提供了通用策略。
items.author_line: Chen, S., Fernandes, N., Li, W. V., Wang, L., Jia, Z., Xiang, J. S.

items.title: Auditing LLM Chemical Priors for Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization of Chemical Reactions: A Validity, Alignment, and Diversity Benchmark
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as priors for cold-starting Bayesian optimization (BO) of chemical reactions, yet their benefit–risk profile in multi-objective reaction optimization remains poorly characterized. We present a systematic benchmark asking when LLM knowledge helps, is neutral, or hurts multi-objective BO (MOBO). Across seven public reaction benchmarks (6,384 candidate experiments), we compare nine strategies—including LLM-initialized BO, an LLM-only initializer, and established baselines (TSEMO, EDBO+-style scalarization, LLAMBO)—with 20 seeds per configuration (1,120 main-grid plus 360 ablation campaigns), scored by hypervolume completion and its sampling-efficiency integral (AUC), with paired Wilcoxon tests and two-family Benjamini–Hochberg correction against a random-init BO control. Three regimes emerge. On Suzuki–Miyaura, LLM initialization significantly improves sampling efficiency (ΔAUC +2.0 points, q = 0.026; alternative backbone +2.7 points, q = 1.4 × 10⁻⁴). On Buchwald–Hartwig, LLM priors are statistically indistinguishable from random. On a process-development coupling, LLM initialization significantly harms efficiency (ΔAUC −11.1 points, q = 0.0016) despite a 0% out-of-pool rate, whereas the Suzuki benefit coexists with a 45% out-of-pool rate—the prior’s direction, not its syntactic validity, controls the outcome. Diversity-based initialization (farthest point sampling) matches or exceeds LLM initialization wherever LLMs help, and no LLM-derived benefit exceeds what the knowledge-free diversity control already provides. A five-category diagnostic protocol intercepts 100% out-of-pool suggestions on the flow cases at zero experimental cost. LLM priors are not yet a reliable default for multi-objective reaction optimization; we provide a cost-free pre-campaign screening heuristic for deciding when to trust them.
items.summary_zh: 在7个公开反应基准、6,384个候选实验和20个随机种子上系统审计 LLM 先验用于多目标贝叶斯反应优化的收益与风险，并与随机初始化和多样性初始化比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 给出了 LLM 先验何时有益、无效或有害的定量证据，提醒反应优化不能默认信任语言模型知识，并提出无需额外实验成本的预筛选协议。限制是结论基于公开基准和模拟候选池，真实实验噪声与新反应体系仍可能改变结果。
items.abstract_zh: 人们越来越多地提出使用大语言模型（LLM）作为化学反应贝叶斯优化（BO）的先验，以启动冷启动过程；但在多目标反应优化中，其收益-风险特征仍缺乏充分刻画。我们提出一个系统基准，研究 LLM 知识何时帮助、无效或损害多目标 BO（MOBO）。在7个公开反应基准（6,384个候选实验）上，我们比较9种策略，包括 LLM 初始化的 BO、仅由 LLM 产生的初始化器，以及既有基线（TSEMO、EDBO+-style scalarization、LLAMBO）；每种配置使用20个随机种子（主网格1,120次，加上消融实验360次），并用超体积完成度及其采样效率积分（AUC）评分，同时针对随机初始化 BO 对照进行配对 Wilcoxon 检验和两类 Benjamini–Hochberg 校正。结果出现三种情形。在 Suzuki–Miyaura 反应中，LLM 初始化显著提高采样效率（ΔAUC +2.0 points，q = 0.026；另一种 backbone 为 +2.7 points，q = 1.4 × 10⁻⁴）。在 Buchwald–Hartwig 反应中，LLM 先验与随机初始化在统计上没有差异。在一个工艺开发偶联反应中，尽管池外率为0%，LLM 初始化却显著降低效率（ΔAUC −11.1 points，q = 0.0016）；而 Suzuki 的收益伴随着45%的池外率——决定结果的是先验的方向，而不是其语法有效性。多样性初始化（最远点采样）在 LLM 有帮助的场合达到或超过 LLM 初始化，而且没有任何 LLM 派生收益超过无知识多样性对照所能提供的收益。一个五类别诊断协议在流动反应案例中以零实验成本拦截了100%的池外建议。LLM 先验尚不是多目标反应优化的可靠默认选项；我们提供了一种无成本的预实验筛选启发式方法，用于决定何时信任它们。
items.author_line: Fan Zhang

items.title: Prediction of organic additive-induced rheological enhancement of CTAB solutions using machine learning methods
items.abstract_or_text: Various organic additives can induce structural rearrangement of surfactant micelles in aqueous solutions, leading to enhanced rheological properties, namely an increase in viscosity, appearance of viscoelasticity, and non-Newtonian behavior. This phenomenon can be exploited in several industries to obtain strong gels. The selection of proper additives and their concentrations remains largely empirical owing to the high number of factors influencing structural rearrangement. This paper aims to employ machine learning (ML) methods to predict whether an enhancement of rheological behavior will occur in cetyltrimethylammonium bromide solutions (CTAB) upon addition of an organic compound. Five different shallow ML algorithms were tested along with graph neural networks (GNNs), using a dataset of 605 data points collected from the literature. Two types of descriptors (RDKit and PaDEL) were applied. Shallow ML algorithms achieved a maximum precision of 0.85 under cross-validation with a random fold split, and this performance did not deteriorate significantly when a structure-based split was applied (0.82). The random forest algorithm was selected based on its comparatively stable performance. GNN achieved a precision of 0.85 (random split) and 0.80 (structure-based split). Analysis of relative contribution of system properties and molecular features to the predictions of shallow and GNN models is consistent with the known physicochemical basis. Experimental validation of ML methods on four prospective compounds unseen during training was carried out. Comparison with ML predictions demonstrated that both models can correctly identify compounds that promote rheological enhancement, but tend to overpredict positive outcomes. However, this drawback may be partially mitigated by applying a pessimistic consensus, and then the accuracy of 0.84 and the precision of 0.73 are achieved for evaluation on the experimental dataset. The present work demonstrates that ML methods can be applied to address the problem of surfactant self-aggregation in solution upon addition of organic additives with room remaining for performance improvement.
items.summary_zh: 利用605条文献数据，以浅层机器学习和图神经网络预测有机添加剂是否会增强 CTAB 溶液流变性能，并对4个训练外候选物进行前瞻性实验验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把分子描述符、体系性质与表面活性剂自聚集现象联系起来，并展示了从文献数据到未见化合物验证的完整流程。限制是数据规模小、正例过预测明显，且体系限定于 CTAB 和特定添加剂范围。
items.abstract_zh: 各种有机添加剂能够诱导水溶液中表面活性剂胶束发生结构重排，从而增强流变性质，即黏度增加、出现黏弹性和非牛顿行为。这一现象可用于多个行业以获得强凝胶。由于影响结构重排的因素很多，合适添加剂及其浓度的选择在很大程度上仍依赖经验。本论文旨在使用机器学习（ML）方法预测向十六烷基三甲基溴化铵（CTAB）溶液中加入有机化合物后是否会发生流变增强。研究测试了5种不同的浅层 ML 算法和图神经网络（GNN），使用了从文献收集的605个数据点，并采用两类描述符（RDKit 和 PaDEL）。在随机折分交叉验证下，浅层 ML 算法的最高精确率达到0.85；在基于结构的划分下，性能没有显著下降，达到0.82。综合性能稳定性后选择随机森林算法。GNN 在随机划分和结构划分下的精确率分别为0.85和0.80。对体系性质和分子特征相对贡献的分析与已知的物理化学基础一致。研究还对4个训练期间未见、具有前瞻性的化合物进行了 ML 方法实验验证。与 ML 预测比较表明，两类模型都能正确识别促进流变增强的化合物，但往往会过度预测阳性结果。不过，采用悲观共识可以部分缓解这一缺点，在实验数据集上的准确率和精确率分别达到0.84和0.73。本研究表明，ML 方法可以用于处理有机添加剂引发溶液中表面活性剂自聚集的问题，但性能仍有改进空间。
items.author_line: Timur Yunusov

items.title: A Taxonomy-Informed Sparse DNA Foundation Model for Microbial Genomics
items.abstract_or_text: Microorganisms are crucial to Earth's ecosystems, with genomes encoding functions important to agriculture, biotechnology and human health. Although genomic language models have advanced DNA representation learning, the extensive diversity of microorganisms and highly imbalanced taxonomic composition of existing pretraining corpora pose challenges for effective microbial genomic sequence modeling. Here we present MicroGlot, a taxonomy-informed microbial DNA foundation model pretrained on 3.70 million sequences comprising 378.3 billion nucleotides from 99,700 species. MicroGlot represents hierarchical relationships among taxa using hyperbolic embeddings and integrates this knowledge into a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture. Probing frozen embeddings across layers showed that MicroGlot captures both microbial phenotypic traits and taxonomic identity. Compared with a taxonomy-ablated variant pretrained under the same scheme, incorporating taxonomic knowledge consistently improved representation quality across model depth. Combining sparse computation with efficient architectural and training techniques, MicroGlot achieved competitive probing and fine-tuning performance with low computational requirements. Species-level expert-routing fingerprints aligned more closely with taxonomic groups than tetranucleotide-frequency profiles, indicating that expert usage recapitulates taxonomic structure. These results show that combining sparse architecture with taxonomic knowledge enables efficient and biologically informative genomic language modeling across diverse microbial taxa. MicroGlot is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/athanzli/MicroGlot.
items.summary_zh: MicroGlot 在 99,700 个物种、3.70 million 条序列和 378.3 billion 个核苷酸上预训练，将分类学双曲嵌入融入稀疏 mixture-of-experts 架构。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把微生物分类学先验与稀疏计算结合，在大规模跨物种基因组建模中提高表示质量并降低计算要求，模型权重已公开。
items.abstract_zh: 微生物对地球生态系统至关重要，其基因组编码着对农业、生物技术和人类健康重要的功能。尽管基因组语言模型推动了 DNA 表征学习，但微生物的高度多样性以及现有预训练语料库中分类组成的严重不平衡，给有效的微生物基因组序列建模带来了挑战。我们提出 MicroGlot，这是一种融入分类学信息的微生物 DNA 基础模型，在包含 99,700 个物种的 3.70 million 条序列、共 378.3 billion 个核苷酸上进行预训练。MicroGlot 使用双曲嵌入表示分类单元之间的层级关系，并将这些知识整合进稀疏 mixture-of-experts 架构。对冻结嵌入进行跨层探测显示，MicroGlot 能够捕捉微生物表型特征和分类学身份。与在相同方案下预训练、但去除分类学信息的变体相比，纳入分类学知识在不同模型深度上持续提高了表示质量。通过结合稀疏计算与高效的架构和训练技术，MicroGlot 以较低的计算要求取得了具有竞争力的探测和微调性能。物种层面的专家路由指纹与分类群的对应关系比四核苷酸频率谱更紧密，表明专家使用模式重现了分类学结构。这些结果表明，将稀疏架构与分类学知识结合，能够在多样微生物类群中实现高效且具有生物学信息的基因组语言建模。MicroGlot 已公开发布于 https://huggingface.co/athanzli/MicroGlot。
