items.title: A ReAct Agentic AI System for Natural Language Querying and Statistical Analysis of The Cancer Genome Atlas Clinical Data
items.abstract_or_text: The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) holds clinical data for over 11,000 patients across 33 cancer types, but access is hard because of complex file structures, heterogeneous formats, and the need for programming. We present an agentic system for natural language querying and statistical analysis of TCGA clinical data. The system uses a large language model as an autonomous ReAct agent that selects from eight computational tools, including data extraction, descriptive statistics, Kaplan-Meier survival analysis with log-rank tests, hypothesis testing, and verification against the curated TCGA Pan-Cancer Clinical Data Resource (CDR). The agent reasons about intermediate results, adapts its approach, and returns clinically contextualized responses with source attribution and auditable traces. We introduce TCGA-Agent-Bench, 440 queries across five difficulty tiers with ground truth from the independently curated TCGA-CDR, evaluated with dual metrics of numerical accuracy and clinical completeness. The system achieves 93.4% overall accuracy (100% single-patient lookups, 99.1% cohort statistics, 92.8% comparative analyses), outperforming a fixed rule-based pipeline (87.1%), a single-pass LLM (81.8%), and retrieval-augmented generation (66.9% on a subset). Most of the benchmark is answerable from the CDR alone, so we locate the extraction layer's value in fields the CDR lacks (drug treatments, TNM components, biomarkers, biospecimen metadata): on 26 queries targeting these, the full system answers 100% versus 3.8% for CDR-only. Ablations show the reasoning loop is most impactful (+9.1% accuracy, +22.0 completeness points). A tool-based agentic architecture enables accurate, auditable analysis of clinical repositories, with value driven by tool design and recovered fields rather than model scale.
items.summary_zh: TCGA-Agent 以 ReAct 智能体调用 8 类工具查询和分析超过 11,000 名患者、33 种癌症的 TCGA 临床数据，在 440 个问题上达到 93.4% 总体准确率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把自然语言查询、统计分析、来源归因和可审计轨迹结合起来，并通过消融显示工具设计和恢复 CDR 缺失字段比模型规模更关键。
items.abstract_zh: The Cancer Genome Atlas（TCGA）包含来自 33 种癌症、超过 11,000 名患者的临床数据，但由于文件结构复杂、格式异质且需要编程，数据访问较为困难。我们提出一个用于自然语言查询和统计分析 TCGA 临床数据的智能体系统。该系统使用大型语言模型作为自主 ReAct 智能体，从 8 个计算工具中选择，包括数据提取、描述性统计、带 log-rank 检验的 Kaplan-Meier 生存分析、假设检验，以及与经整理的 TCGA Pan-Cancer Clinical Data Resource（CDR）进行核验。智能体对中间结果进行推理，调整分析路径，并返回带有来源归因和可审计轨迹的临床语境化回答。我们引入 TCGA-Agent-Bench，其中包含 5 个难度层级的 440 个查询，其真实答案来自独立整理的 TCGA-CDR，并使用数值准确性和临床完整性两项指标进行评估。系统总体准确率为 93.4%（单患者查询 100%，队列统计 99.1%，比较分析 92.8%），优于固定规则管线（87.1%）、单次推理 LLM（81.8%）和检索增强生成（在一个子集上为 66.9%）。由于大多数基准问题仅凭 CDR 即可回答，我们将提取层的价值定位在 CDR 缺失的字段（药物治疗、TNM 组成部分、生物标志物、生物样本元数据）：在针对这些字段的 26 个查询中，完整系统回答正确率为 100%，而仅使用 CDR 时为 3.8%。消融实验显示，推理循环的影响最大（准确率 +9.1%，完整性 +22.0 个百分点）。基于工具的智能体架构能够准确、可审计地分析临床数据库，其价值主要由工具设计和恢复出的字段驱动，而非模型规模。
items.author_line: Korutla, R., Amal, S.

items.title: Benchmarking single-cell foundation models for aging biology
items.abstract_or_text: Single cell foundation models (scFMs) provide representations of cellular states, but their utility across biological questions in aging research remains unclear. We established a benchmark of cellular representations for aging research, evaluating ten general-purpose scFMs, three aging-specific models and conventional methods across five biological questions using more than 2.5 million single cell transcriptomes. Using frozen pretrained representations, Geneformer performed best among scFMs for chronological age prediction and age pseudotime concordance, although 2,000 highly variable genes achieved higher mean performance. Several scFMs captured positive molecular age shifts across three disease contexts, consistent with reported aging-associated changes. SCimilarity performed well for rare cellular state identification across out-of-distribution datasets, exceeding aging specific models and conventional baselines. At the gene level, scGPT showed the highest recovery of reference TF target interactions, including aging-related regulatory hubs. Overall, scFMs supported diverse aging analyses, but performance depended on the biological question, highlighting their utility for rare cellular state identification and regulatory analysis.
items.summary_zh: 研究者在 >2.5 million 个单细胞转录组上系统比较 10 个通用、3 个衰老特异性单细胞基础模型与传统方法在五类衰老问题上的表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示模型优势依赖具体生物学问题：SCimilarity 更适合分布外稀有状态识别，scGPT 更擅长转录因子靶标关系恢复，而简单的高变基因基线在年龄预测上仍可能更强。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞基础模型（scFM）提供细胞状态的表征，但其在衰老研究不同生物学问题中的实用性仍不清楚。我们建立了一个面向衰老研究的细胞表征基准，使用超过 2.5 million 个单细胞转录组，在五个生物学问题上评估 10 个通用 scFM、3 个衰老特异性模型和传统方法。使用冻结的预训练表征时，在 scFM 中 Geneformer 在生理年龄预测和年龄伪时间一致性方面表现最佳，尽管 2,000 个高变基因取得了更高的平均性能。多个 scFM 在 3 个疾病背景下捕捉到正向的分子年龄偏移，与已报道的衰老相关变化一致。SCimilarity 在分布外数据集中的稀有细胞状态识别方面表现良好，超过了衰老特异性模型和传统基线。在基因层面，scGPT 对参考转录因子靶标相互作用的恢复能力最高，其中包括与衰老相关的调控枢纽。总体而言，scFM 支持多样的衰老分析，但性能取决于具体生物学问题，说明其在稀有细胞状态识别和调控分析中具有实用价值。
items.author_line: Ni, X., Liang, Y., Zhu, J., Zhang, L., Shen, X., Yang, M., Xu, R., Li, H., Ji, R., Jin, C., Ni, S.

items.title: SHERLOCK: Structured representation learning and causal inference of downstream perturbation effects
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding the effects of genetic, molecular, and experimental perturbations is essential for decoding cellular mechanisms and guiding biomedical interventions. Existing computational approaches are typically designed for individual tasks, such as predicting perturbation responses, characterizing downstream transcriptional effects, or modeling perturbation combinations, and therefore do not provide a unified framework for learning interpretable perturbation representations while enabling causal analysis of downstream effects and characterization of condition-dependent responses. We present SHERLOCK, an interpretable deep generative framework for single-cell perturbation analysis that represents perturbation effects as structured interventions on a latent baseline cellular state. SHERLOCK learns correlated and sparse perturbation representations that organize genetic and pharmacological perturbations according to shared transcriptional responses. % By formulating perturbations as interventions within a structural causal model, it enables counterfactual estimation of their downstream transcriptional effects under explicit identifiability assumptions. The same framework quantifies how perturbation responses vary across conditions and compositionally models combinatorial perturbations, enabling prediction of held-out combinations and classification of genetic interactions. Across genome-scale CRISPR, chemical, and spatial perturbation datasets, SHERLOCK recovers perturbation relationships concordant with known biological pathways and pharmacological properties, identifies condition-dependent responses, and predicts combinatorial perturbation effects. Together, SHERLOCK provides a unified framework for interpretable and causal analysis of perturbation effects across diverse single-cell perturbation experiments.
items.summary_zh: SHERLOCK 将遗传、药理和实验扰动表示为潜在基线细胞状态上的结构化干预，并在基因组规模 CRISPR、化学和空间扰动数据上进行组合效应与反事实分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架统一了扰动表示、条件响应、组合扰动预测和因果推断；摘要明确依赖可识别性假设，结果应理解为模型分析而非已证实的因果机制。
items.abstract_zh: 理解遗传、分子和实验扰动的影响，对于解析细胞机制和指导生物医学干预至关重要。现有计算方法通常针对单一任务设计，例如预测扰动响应、刻画下游转录效应或建模扰动组合，因此无法提供一个统一框架，既学习可解释的扰动表示，又能对下游效应进行因果分析并刻画依赖条件的响应。我们提出 SHERLOCK，这是一种用于单细胞扰动分析的可解释深度生成框架，将扰动效应表示为对潜在基线细胞状态的结构化干预。SHERLOCK 学习相关且稀疏的扰动表示，依据共同的转录响应对遗传和药理扰动进行组织。通过将扰动表述为结构因果模型中的干预，它能够在明确的可识别性假设下估计其下游转录效应的反事实。相同框架还量化扰动响应如何随条件变化，并对组合扰动进行组合建模，从而实现对留出组合的预测和遗传互作分类。在全基因组规模 CRISPR、化学和空间扰动数据集上，SHERLOCK 恢复出的扰动关系与已知生物学通路和药理性质一致，识别出依赖条件的响应，并预测组合扰动效应。总体而言，SHERLOCK 为不同单细胞扰动实验中的扰动效应提供了一个统一的、可解释且具有因果分析能力的框架。
items.author_line: Zhang, M., Myers, J. D., Shi, L., Giglio, R. M., Chatterjee, S., McFaline-Figueroa, J. L., Azizi, E.

items.title: LucaCell: a sequence-centric foundation model for cross-species single-cell analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Single-cell foundation models have transformed transcriptomic analysis, yet most rely on fixed gene identifiers that limit transfer across species and data types. Here we present LucaCell, a sequence-centric foundation model that represents genes through pre-trained mRNA sequence embeddings rather than static gene annotations. Gene expression is discretized into bins and modeled with a Transformer encoder, enabling sequence-informed cell representations that generalize across species and data types. Pre-training on 85 million human and mouse single cells, LucaCell enables cross-species and cross-modal cell type transfer in human, mouse, and lemur kidney datasets; alignment-free microbial embedding that distinguishes more than 50 bacterial species while preserving intra-species physiological states; and accurate host-virus interaction prediction across five influenza A virus strains. In addition, LucaCell incorporates donor-specific exonic SNPs to refine gene expression reconstruction and improves perturbation response prediction. Together, these results show that transcript-sequence information provides a transferable prior for single-cell foundation modeling across species, modalities, and biological contexts.
items.summary_zh: LucaCell 以预训练 mRNA 序列嵌入替代固定基因标识符，在 85 million 个单细胞上预训练并实现跨物种、跨模态细胞类型迁移及宿主—病毒互作预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 以转录本序列作为可迁移先验，缓解固定基因 ID 对跨物种分析的限制，并在灵长类、微生物和流感病毒任务上展示跨生物学场景泛化。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞基础模型已经改变了转录组分析，但大多数模型依赖固定的基因标识符，限制了它们在物种和数据类型之间的迁移。我们提出 LucaCell，这是一种以序列为中心的基础模型，不使用静态基因注释，而是通过预训练的 mRNA 序列嵌入来表示基因。我们将基因表达离散为多个区间，并使用 Transformer 编码器进行建模，从而得到由序列信息驱动、可在物种和数据类型之间泛化的细胞表示。在 85 million 个来自人和小鼠的单细胞上进行预训练后，LucaCell 在人、小鼠和狐猴肾脏数据集中实现跨物种和跨模态细胞类型迁移；实现无需比对的微生物嵌入，可区分 50 多种细菌，同时保留种内生理状态；并在 5 种甲型流感病毒株上准确预测宿主—病毒相互作用。此外，LucaCell 纳入供体特异性的外显子 SNP，以细化基因表达重建，并改善扰动响应预测。总体而言，这些结果表明，转录本序列信息为单细胞基础建模提供了可迁移的先验，可跨越物种、模态和生物学场景。
items.author_line: Sun Y, He Y, Ren M, Wang Y, Xu P, Hou Y, Kang Y, Hou T, Ye J, Yang H, Wang Z

items.title: HCOE: Hyperbolic Clinical Ontology Embeddings from Biomedical Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Biomedical language models (LMs) encode textual semantics but do not explicitly preserve medical code hierarchies. We present Hyperbolic Clinical Ontology Embeddings (HCOE) for hierarchy-aware clinical concept representation. HCOE maps frozen BioBERT embeddings into a Poincare ball, combining parent-side and child-side ontology-guided contrastive learning with coarse-to-fine ontology-path aggregation. It uses International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes organized by Clinical Classifications Software (CCS) and Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) medication hierarchies. Evaluations show that HCOE performs best on ICD/ATC clinical relation prediction and CCS-to-PheCode hierarchy transfer. On the MIMIC-IV dataset, HCOE also achieves the best performance on mortality prediction, readmission prediction, medication recommendation, and rare drug prediction.
items.summary_zh: HCOE 将冻结 BioBERT 嵌入映射到 Poincare 球，并结合双向本体对比学习和粗到细路径聚合，改善 ICD/ATC 关系预测及 MIMIC-IV 多项临床任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法显式保留医学编码层级，覆盖临床关系、层级迁移、死亡率和再入院预测、用药推荐及罕见药物预测，但仍属于 preprint 结果。
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学语言模型（LM）编码文本语义，但不会显式保留医学代码层级。我们提出 Hyperbolic Clinical Ontology Embeddings（HCOE），用于具有层级意识的临床概念表示。HCOE 将冻结的 BioBERT 嵌入映射到 Poincare 球，并结合面向本体父节点和子节点的对比学习以及粗到细的本体路径聚合。它使用按 Clinical Classifications Software（CCS）组织的 International Classification of Diseases（ICD）代码层级和 Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical（ATC）药物层级。评估显示，HCOE 在 ICD/ATC 临床关系预测和 CCS 到 PheCode 的层级迁移上表现最佳。在 MIMIC-IV 数据集上，HCOE 在死亡率预测、再入院预测、用药推荐和罕见药物预测方面也取得最佳性能。
items.author_line: Yixuan Li, Weihao Li, Ziyang Song

items.title: OmicsResonance: An LLM-assisted cloud ecosystem for interactive and reproducible single-cell transcriptomic analysis
items.abstract_or_text: While single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) is indispensable, existing analytical tools impose high computational barriers, requiring complex environment configurations and programming proficiency. To democratize single-cell analysis, we developed OmicsResonance, a code-free, web-based platform that eliminates local installations and empowers researchers to execute end-to-end analyses directly within a browser. The platform integrates standard processing pipelines and Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted cell annotation with a suite of advanced modules, including pseudo-time inference, CNV profiling, and virtual knockout simulations. Built on a scalable architecture, OmicsResonance champions "justified analysis" by avoiding black-box defaults. Its interactive interface allows users to dynamically adjust parameters and instantly visualize biological impacts, ensuring transparent and biologically sound analytical decisions. Validation across three public datasets successfully reproduced established findings and facilitated further interpretation of the data. Ultimately, OmicsResonance bridges the gap between complex computational pipelines and bench research, providing an accessible yet powerful environment for scRNA-seq data exploration. The platform is available at https://cloud.rnastar.com/.
items.summary_zh: OmicsResonance 是无代码浏览器平台，整合单细胞标准流程、LLM 细胞注释、伪时间、CNV 和 virtual knockout，并在三个公开数据集上复现既有结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 平台降低单细胞分析的计算和编程门槛，强调参数可调、可视化和“justified analysis”，并提供公开在线入口，但功能的独立复现仍需更多验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）不可或缺，现有分析工具却带来了很高的计算门槛，需要复杂的环境配置和编程能力。为使单细胞分析民主化，我们开发了 OmicsResonance，这是一个无代码、基于 Web 的平台，无需本地安装即可让研究人员直接在浏览器中执行端到端分析。该平台整合标准处理流程和大型语言模型（LLM）辅助的细胞注释，并提供一系列高级模块，包括伪时间推断、CNV 分析和 virtual knockout 模拟。基于可扩展架构，OmicsResonance 倡导“justified analysis”，避免黑箱式默认设置。其交互界面允许用户动态调整参数并即时可视化生物学影响，从而实现透明且符合生物学依据的分析决策。在 3 个公开数据集上的验证成功复现了既有发现，并促进了对数据的进一步解读。总体而言，OmicsResonance 弥合了复杂计算流程与台式实验研究之间的鸿沟，为 scRNA-seq 数据探索提供了易于使用且功能强大的环境。该平台可访问 https://cloud.rnastar.com/。
items.author_line: Chenhui L, Zhizhen Q, Yi L, Qinfen W, Yan-kai C, Yi L, Mingjie C, Lin Z

items.title: Response-state Learning for Transferable Vibrational Spectroscopic Characterization with Electron Prior
items.abstract_or_text: Vibrational spectral prediction can become inaccurate when localized stereoelectronic environments perturb intermediate response states and high-risk response units dominate characteristic spectral fingerprints, making prediction across external chemical space difficult. SO(3) Equivariant Neural Kalman Networks (SENK) form a response-state cascade that combines an equivariant transformer backbone for Hessian, dipole-derivative and polarizability-derivative learning, an Equivariant Neural Kalman bridge for state-dependent refinement and reliability sensing, and an NBO-informed electronic-prior pathway coupling consistency regularization with bounded, branch-specific guided spectral calibration. SENK outperforms DetaNet on QM9S and QMe14S while preserving full-spectrum IR and Raman fidelity from small molecules to drug-like systems. SENK remains stable and selectively improves spectrally sensitive features in biomolecular systems with complex stereoelectronic effects. It therefore integrates tensor prediction, reliability diagnosis and physics-informed calibration, supporting transferable vibrational spectroscopy from molecular systems to functional molecular materials.
items.summary_zh: 提出 SENK 响应状态学习框架，将 SO(3) 等变 Transformer、等变神经 Kalman 桥接、NBO 电子先验和光谱校准结合，用于可迁移的 IR 与 Raman 光谱预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对立体电子环境导致的响应态变化和外部化学空间迁移问题，引入可靠性诊断与物理先验校准，并在 QM9S、QMe14S 及药物样分子上报告改进。限制是摘要未提供实验光谱验证或详细误差分解。
items.abstract_zh: 当局部立体电子环境扰动中间响应态，且高风险响应单元主导特征光谱指纹时，振动光谱预测可能变得不准确，从而难以跨外部化学空间预测。SO(3) 等变神经 Kalman 网络（SENK）形成响应态级联：它结合用于 Hessian、偶极导数和极化率导数学习的等变 Transformer 骨干网络、用于状态依赖细化和可靠性感知的等变神经 Kalman 桥接，以及 NBO 约束的电子先验通路；后者将一致性正则化与有界、分支特异的引导光谱校准相结合。SENK 在 QM9S 和 QMe14S 上优于 DetaNet，同时保持从小分子到药物样分子的全谱 IR 和 Raman 保真度。对于具有复杂立体电子效应的生物分子系统，SENK 仍然稳定，并有选择性地改善对光谱敏感的特征。因此，它整合了张量预测、可靠性诊断和物理信息校准，为从分子体系到功能分子材料的可迁移振动光谱预测提供支持。
items.author_line: Zetong Li, Zhuosong Xie, Hengyu Fan, Jiaao Yu, Qiyao Hua, Zheng Lu, Liming Xu, Juanni Wu, Honglin Li

items.title: Spectral Feedback for Test-Time Alignment of Protein Diffusion Models
items.abstract_or_text: Reward maximization alignment methods for discrete diffusion models have primarily focused on steering the reverse process, either by influencing token logits or by selecting favorable sequences at intermediate steps. These approaches largely treat inference as a unidirectional process, lacking mechanisms for revisiting undesirable token selections. We introduce Spectral Feedback, an algorithm that selects edit-positions in a feedback loop, allowing the model to iteratively correct its own generations. This approach leverages the mask structure of discrete diffusion models by re-masking and re-sampling tokens, analogous to image editing methods that reintroduce noisy latents and re-run the reverse process. While prior alignment methods focus on what token labels to assign to maximize a target reward, we instead treat which tokens to revisit as the central alignment problem. Selecting edit-positions is challenging because edit effects are interdependent: the impact of modifying one token depends on which others are edited simultaneously. We define an edit-set as a set of token positions to re-mask and re-sample. Motivated by prior work on sparse interactions in biological systems, we find empirically that edit-set value functions for protein inverse folding admit sparse Fourier representations. This structure enables Spectral Feedback to efficiently learn and optimize the value functions for edit-position selection. Spectral Feedback is model-agnostic and can be applied to pretrained, test-time aligned, and fine-tuned diffusion models. For all of these models, the algorithm improves alignment performance without modifying the underlying generative process. Applied to inverse folding with a protein stability reward oracle, it achieves a 32.3% increase in stable proteins for a pretrained model, 24.8% for Best-of-10, and 5.8% for a state-of-the-art RL fine-tuned diffusion model.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Spectral Feedback，在离散蛋白质扩散模型的测试时通过反复重新掩码和重采样选择待编辑 token，利用稀疏 Fourier 表示优化编辑集合价值函数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把对齐问题从“生成什么 token”转向“回看哪些位置”，在不修改底层生成过程的情况下提升蛋白质稳定性奖励表现。限制是验证依赖稳定性 reward oracle 和逆折叠任务，能否迁移到真实实验性质仍不明确。
items.abstract_zh: 针对离散扩散模型的奖励最大化对齐方法主要聚焦于引导反向过程，例如影响 token logits 或在中间步骤选择有利序列。这些方法大多把推理视为单向过程，缺少重新访问不理想 token 选择的机制。我们提出 Spectral Feedback，一种在反馈循环中选择编辑位置的算法，使模型能够通过重新掩码和重新采样 token 迭代修正自身生成，类似于图像编辑方法重新引入噪声潜变量并再次运行反向过程。以往的对齐方法关注分配哪些 token 标签来最大化目标奖励；相比之下，我们将选择哪些 token 需要重新访问视为核心对齐问题。编辑位置的选择很困难，因为编辑效果彼此依赖：修改一个 token 的影响取决于同时编辑哪些其他 token。我们将编辑集合定义为一组需要重新掩码和重新采样的 token 位置。受生物系统稀疏相互作用的既有研究启发，我们经验性发现，蛋白质逆折叠的编辑集合价值函数具有稀疏 Fourier 表示。这一结构使 Spectral Feedback 能够高效学习并优化编辑位置选择的价值函数。Spectral Feedback 与模型无关，可应用于预训练、测试时对齐和微调后的扩散模型。在所有这些模型上，该算法都能在不改变底层生成过程的情况下改善对齐性能。应用于以蛋白质稳定性为奖励 oracle 的逆折叠时，相比预训练模型，它使稳定蛋白质比例提高32.3%；相比 Best-of-10，提高24.8%；相比最先进的 RL 微调扩散模型，提高5.8%。
items.author_line: Shai Dickman, Mert Cemri, Landon Butler, Kannan Ramchandran

items.title: Detecting Glaucoma Across Multi-ethnic Myopic and Non-Myopic Populations Using an Uncertainty-Aware Vision Transformer: A Multicentre Model Development and Validation Study
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based glaucoma detection from colour fundus photographs (CFP) offers scalable screening, but performance may decline on external datasets because of differences in ground-truth definitions, populations, and coexisting conditions such as high myopia (HM). We developed and validated a Vision Transformer-based deep learning (DL) model for glaucoma detection across multi-ethnic cohorts with and without HM. Methods: A ViT-B/16 model with predictive uncertainty estimation was developed using 56,483 CFPs (57.1% with myopia; 14.4% with HM). Glaucoma labels were standardised using clinical, imaging, and perimetry data. The model was validated on 16 independent datasets across three continents, including four datasets with explicit HM labels. Findings: Internal AUROC was 98.7% (95% CI 98.2-99.1%), with sensitivity 94.5% and specificity 97.3%. Across 16 external datasets from eight countries, AUROCs ranged from 86.4% to 99.6%. In HM eyes, internal AUROC was 97.8% (95% CI 96.1-99.2%), with sensitivity 94.8% and specificity 93.7%. External HM AUROCs were 86.5% in the Beijing Eye Study and 93.3%, 91.8%, and 85.5% in hospital-based datasets from Taiwan, Thailand, and South Korea. In an exploratory HM clinical evaluation, the model had higher CFP-only diagnostic accuracy than ophthalmologists and trained graders (92.0% vs 70.0%; p=0.008) and performed comparably to glaucoma specialists using full clinical information. Interpretation: The model showed robust glaucoma detection across myopic and non-myopic multi-ethnic populations and may support AI-assisted screening in settings with high HM prevalence.
items.summary_zh: 不确定性感知的 ViT-B/16 在 56,483 张眼底照片上开发，并在三大洲 16 个独立数据集和高近视亚组中进行多中心验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型显式处理高近视和多族群外部泛化问题，外部 AUROC 范围为 86.4%-99.6%，但摘要仅支持辅助筛查用途，不能等同于临床替代。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：基于人工智能（AI）的彩色眼底照片（CFP）青光眼检测可实现规模化筛查，但由于金标准定义、人群以及高近视（HM）等共存条件的差异，其在外部数据集上的性能可能下降。我们开发并验证了一个基于 Vision Transformer 的深度学习（DL）模型，用于在有或无 HM 的多族群队列中检测青光眼。方法：使用 56,483 张 CFP 开发带预测不确定性估计的 ViT-B/16 模型，其中 57.1% 存在近视，14.4% 存在 HM。使用临床、影像学和视野检查数据对青光眼标签进行标准化。模型在 3 个大洲的 16 个独立数据集上验证，其中包括 4 个明确标注 HM 的数据集。结果：内部 AUROC 为 98.7%（95% CI 98.2-99.1%），敏感度为 94.5%，特异度为 97.3%。在来自 8 个国家的 16 个外部数据集中，AUROC 范围为 86.4%-99.6%。在 HM 眼中，内部 AUROC 为 97.8%（95% CI 96.1-99.2%），敏感度为 94.8%，特异度为 93.7%。外部 HM AUROC 在 Beijing Eye Study 中为 86.5%，在来自台湾、泰国和韩国的医院数据集中分别为 93.3%、91.8% 和 85.5%。在探索性 HM 临床评估中，模型仅使用 CFP 的诊断准确率高于眼科医师和受训分级员（92.0% 对 70.0%；p=0.008），并且与使用完整临床信息的青光眼专科医师表现相当。解读：该模型在有近视和无近视的多族群人群中展现出稳健的青光眼检测能力，可能支持在 HM 高发环境中开展 AI 辅助筛查。

items.title: NNV3: Expanding Neural Network Verification to New Architectures and Domains
items.abstract_or_text: We present NNV3, the latest version of the Neural Network Verification (NNV) tool, a MATLAB framework for formal verification of deep learning models and learning-enabled cyber-physical systems. Building on the set-based reachability foundation of NNV 1.0 (FFNNs, CNNs, NNCS) and NNV 2.0 (RNNs, SSNNs, neural ODEs), NNV3 introduces new members of the Star-set family: ModelStar for verifying networks under weight perturbation, VolumeStar for video and 3D volumetric inputs, and GraphStar for graph neural networks. A conformal-inference-based probabilistic reachability mode complements sound analysis for problems where deterministic verification is intractable, while FairNNV certifies counterfactual and individual fairness properties over continuous input regions. NNV3 introduces new benchmarks for malware detection, graph-based power-system models, medical imaging, variable-length time series data, and action recognition. NNV3 also incorporates tutorials and developer guides through a unified documentation site. This paper details these major updates, demonstrating NNV's maturation into a comprehensive, robust, and accessible verification tool for a diverse range of AI systems.
items.summary_zh: NNV3 扩展了 Neural Network Verification 工具，加入对权重扰动、视频与三维体数据、图神经网络、概率可达性和公平性的验证能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把多种神经网络架构和应用域纳入统一的集合可达性与概率验证框架，并提供新的跨领域基准。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 NNV3，这是 Neural Network Verification（NNV）工具的最新版本，是一个用于深度学习模型和学习型信息物理系统形式化验证的 MATLAB 框架。NNV3 建立在 NNV 1.0 的集合可达性基础之上，后者支持前馈神经网络、卷积神经网络和神经网络控制系统；也建立在 NNV 2.0 的基础之上，后者支持循环神经网络、状态空间神经网络和神经 ODE。NNV3 引入了 Star 集合家族的新成员：用于验证权重扰动下网络的 ModelStar、用于视频和三维体输入的 VolumeStar，以及用于图神经网络的 GraphStar。基于保形推断的概率可达性模式补充了适用于确定性验证难以处理问题的可靠分析，而 FairNNV 则在连续输入区域上验证反事实公平性和个体公平性。NNV3 还引入了针对恶意软件检测、基于图的电力系统模型、医学成像、可变长度时间序列数据和动作识别的新基准。NNV3 通过统一的文档网站整合教程和开发者指南。本文详细介绍这些主要更新，展示 NNV 正在发展成为面向多种 AI 系统的综合、稳健且易用的验证工具。
items.author_line: Anne M. Tumlin, Samuel Sasaki, Ben Wooding, Diego Manzanas Lopez, Muhammad Usama Zubair, Navid Hashemi, Hongchao Zhang, Waseem Abbas, Ipek Oguz, Meiyi Ma, Taylor T. Johnson

items.title: SAGE: Mitigating Long-Horizon Reasoning Biases via Topological Guidance
items.abstract_or_text: Long-horizon reasoning remains a central challenge for large language models (LLMs) under sparse-reward regimes. We argue that this brittleness arises from two biases induced by complex reasoning spaces: an exploration bias, where models are drawn toward locally plausible but structurally unstable branches, and a compounding bias, where small local deviations accumulate across depth and suppress rare rewards. We introduce Symbolic Closure Analysis (SCA) as a theoretical lens characterizing how branching structures and sparse rewards induce these biases in long-horizon reasoning with local admissibility, and as a design principle for structural priors in less formal reasoning tasks. Motivated by this analysis, we propose SAGE (Structural Admissibility-Guided Exploration), a unified framework that injects structural guidance to alleviate exploration bias and compounding bias in long-horizon reasoning. SAGE combines two complementary structural guidance: algebraic sparsification, which projects locally admissible candidates onto operator-indexed algebraic subspaces to suppress spurious branching and mitigate exploration bias, and hyperbolic structural guidance, which embeds reasoning states into a negatively curved space to provide dense depth-wise signals and mitigate compounding bias. Across 12 benchmarks and 7 model families, SAGE outperforms competitive baselines. In particular, SAGE achieves up to an 8-fold improvement on the Andrews-Curtis problem, an open real-world long-horizon task. Code is available at: https://github.com/Susan571/SAGE-NeurIPS2026.
items.summary_zh: SAGE 用 Symbolic Closure Analysis 分析长程推理中的探索偏差和累积偏差，再结合代数稀疏化与双曲结构引导减少错误分支。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 12 个基准和 7 个模型家族上进行了评测，并报告 Andrews-Curtis 问题最高 8 倍提升，任务和评测范围较清晰。
items.abstract_zh: 在稀疏奖励环境下，长程推理仍是大型语言模型面临的核心挑战。我们认为，这种脆弱性源于复杂推理空间诱导的两种偏差：探索偏差，即模型会被局部看似合理但结构上不稳定的分支吸引；累积偏差，即小的局部偏离会沿深度累积并压制稀有奖励。我们提出 Symbolic Closure Analysis（SCA）作为一种理论视角，用于刻画在局部可接受性条件下，分支结构和稀疏奖励如何在长程推理中诱导这些偏差；同时，它也是在较不形式化的推理任务中设计结构先验的原则。受这一分析启发，我们提出 SAGE（Structural Admissibility-Guided Exploration），一种注入结构引导以缓解探索偏差和累积偏差的统一框架。SAGE 结合了两种互补的结构引导：代数稀疏化将局部可接受候选投影到按算子索引的代数子空间，以抑制虚假分支并减轻探索偏差；双曲结构引导则把推理状态嵌入负曲率空间，以提供逐深度的稠密信号并减轻累积偏差。在 12 个基准和 7 个模型家族上，SAGE 优于有竞争力的基线。特别是在 Andrews-Curtis 问题这一开放的真实长程任务上，SAGE 最高实现了 8 倍提升。代码发布于：https://github.com/Susan571/SAGE-NeurIPS2026。
items.author_line: Xinyue Zeng, Jiawei Zhang, Yujun Yan, Dawei Zhou

items.title: ELF-REG: Scaling Continuous Diffusion Language Models to Reasoning Tasks
items.abstract_or_text: Fully continuous diffusion language models (dLMs) denoise continuous representations without intermediate discretization, then decode all response tokens in parallel at the final step. Their performance on challenging reasoning tasks remains less established than that of autoregressive (AR) LLMs and masked dLMs. We scale Embedded Language Flows (ELF) to mathematical reasoning and code generation on GSM8K, MATH-500, HumanEval, and MBPP. We introduce ELF-REG, which improves learning with representation alignment and entanglement (REPA+REG), where a frozen AR teacher supervises intermediate denoiser features and supplies a global representation that is jointly denoised with the response. ELF-REG-L achieves 55.96% pass@1 on GSM8K at 64 network function evaluations (NFE), and 13.39% on MATH-500 and 22.56% on HumanEval at 128 NFE. It outperforms the evaluated comparable-scale dLMs in pass@1 on GSM8K and code, and improves MATH-500 pass@1 from 10.55% for the ELF-L baseline to 13.39% with ELF-REG-L. Without few-step training, the same task-specific checkpoints support strong low-NFE performance through early-stop, which decodes an intermediate clean prediction without completing the denoising trajectory. At 16 NFE, ELF-REG-L reaches 41.21% HumanEval pass@10, outperforming recent continuous dLMs of comparable scale.
items.summary_zh: ELF-REG 将连续扩散语言模型扩展到数学推理和代码生成，用冻结的自回归教师进行表示对齐与纠缠训练，并报告不同 NFE 下的 pass@1 与 pass@10。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它在 GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval 和 MBPP 上给出明确的速度—准确率结果，说明连续扩散模型在推理任务上的能力可以被直接量化比较。
items.abstract_zh: 完全连续的扩散语言模型（dLM）在不进行中间离散化的情况下对连续表示去噪，并在最后一步并行解码所有响应词元。与自回归（AR）LLM 和掩码 dLM 相比，它们在具有挑战性的推理任务上的性能仍缺乏充分研究。我们将 Embedded Language Flows（ELF）扩展到 GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval 和 MBPP 上的数学推理与代码生成。我们提出 ELF-REG，通过表示对齐与纠缠（REPA+REG）改进学习：冻结的 AR 教师监督中间去噪器特征，并提供一个与响应共同去噪的全局表示。在 64 次网络函数评估（NFE）下，ELF-REG-L 在 GSM8K 上达到 55.96% 的 pass@1；在 128 次 NFE 下，在 MATH-500 和 HumanEval 上分别达到 13.39% 和 22.56%。在 GSM8K 和代码任务的 pass@1 上，它优于所评估的同等规模 dLM，并将 ELF-L 基线在 MATH-500 上的 pass@1 从 10.55% 提升至 13.39%。无需少步训练，同一组特定任务检查点还可以通过 early-stop 支持较强的低 NFE 性能；该方法在未完成去噪轨迹时解码中间的干净预测。在 16 次 NFE 下，ELF-REG-L 的 HumanEval pass@10 达到 41.21%，优于近期同等规模的连续 dLM。
items.author_line: Zeyu Michael Li, William Xingxu Chen, Bingshuo Qian, Jiayin Liu, Xiang Cheng

items.title: Automatic Harness Evolution for Hardware Design Verification: Can LLMs Consolidate Gains Across Discovered Harnesses?
items.abstract_or_text: Agent behavior depends on the harness surrounding a language model, but it remains unclear whether language models can reliably improve such harnesses for hardware-design tasks. We study automatic harness evolution around a fixed subject model on 12 proprietary design-verification root-cause localization tasks. Across five trials per task, automatically evolved harnesses increased completed attempts by 71-76% and any-hit task coverage by 80-100%, while total correct attempts improved by only 18-24%. The strongest success reproducible at least twice result improved by one task, and later candidates exchanged gains across tasks rather than preserving them. An auxiliary candidate improved on a four-task validation set excluded from search but tied its baseline on a subsequent 12-task replay containing both search and validation tasks, so the selected gain did not persist across the full pool. Across the tested lineage, useful search, evidence, and finalization behaviors appeared in different candidates but did not consistently consolidate into a single harness that dominated across tasks and metrics. In a separate CVDP cross-benchmark case study, an automatically evolved defined-width repair harness produced 35.6% more functional passes than its 142-task reference baseline; the final functional verifier scored completed outputs but was not shown to the subject agent during repair. These results support archive-aware selection when evolution yields complementary specializations without consistent consolidation.
items.summary_zh: 该研究考察围绕固定模型自动演化硬件设计验证 harness 是否能稳定整合搜索、证据和最终化能力，并报告跨任务增益难以持续合并。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它不仅报告覆盖率提升，也公开了正确尝试提升有限、验证集收益无法在完整任务池复现等结果，为评估 LLM harness 演化的可靠性提供了反例。
items.abstract_zh: 代理的行为取决于包围语言模型的 harness，但语言模型能否可靠地改进这些 harness 以完成硬件设计任务仍不清楚。我们围绕一个固定的主体模型，研究自动 harness 演化在 12 个专有设计验证根因定位任务上的表现。每个任务进行五次试验，自动演化的 harness 使完成的尝试增加 71%–76%，任意命中任务覆盖率增加 80%–100%，但正确尝试总数仅增加 18%–24%。至少可复现两次的最强成功结果只多解决了一个任务，后续候选在任务之间交换收益，却没有保留这些收益。在一个排除搜索过程的四任务验证集上，某个辅助候选得到改进，但在随后包含搜索集与验证集的 12 任务重放中仅与基线持平，因此该选择性收益没有在完整任务池中持续。沿着所测试的演化谱系，有用的搜索、证据和最终化行为分别出现在不同候选中，但没有稳定整合成一个在各任务和指标上都占优的 harness。在独立的 CVDP 跨基准案例研究中，一个自动演化的定宽修复 harness 比其 142 任务参考基线多产生 35.6% 的功能通过；最终功能验证器对完成的输出进行评分，但在修复期间没有向主体代理展示。这些结果支持在演化产生互补专长而不是一致整合时采用基于档案的选择。
items.author_line: Kidus Seyoum, Ajay Mittur

items.title: GRASP: Generating, Revising, and Assessing for Strategic Planning with Agentic AI
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) typically exhibit a performance profile where reliability degrades as task complexity increases. We address the challenge of generating high-quality natural language executable plans for complex tasks by introducing GRASP, a strategy-aware, multi-stage planning framework. GRASP decouples the planning pipeline across specialized, context-isolated modules: it pre-compiles global macro-guidelines (GenPlan), explores alternative localized strategies within isolated context windows (RevPlan), and independently evaluates trajectories using a multi-criteria discriminator (VerPlan). Empirical evaluations show that GRASP consistently establishes a new state-of-the-art frontier across diverse datasets, yielding substantial accuracy gains over direct LLM planners on Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling (\sim12.4\%\uparrow), ZebraLogic (\sim30.8\%\uparrow), and SciBench Math. Crucially, under multi-task scaling-where standard planners suffer immediate performance collapse-GRASP completely flattens the multi-task degradation penalty. In interleaved dual-task environments, GRASP achieves an absolute accuracy gain of up to 16.7\% over direct LLM planners. Furthermore, by isolating context and enforcing strict macro-regularization, GRASP outperforms frontier reasoning models (such as GPT-5-mini) by a margin of 14.5\%.
items.summary_zh: GRASP 将复杂计划拆为全局规则编译、局部策略修订和独立轨迹评估三个隔离模块，并在多任务场景下检验推理可靠性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在日历调度、ZebraLogic 和 SciBench Math 上相对直接规划器有明确增益，还专门报告多任务退化和与 GPT-5-mini 的比较。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）通常呈现出这样一种性能特征：随着任务复杂度增加，可靠性会下降。我们通过提出 GRASP，一种具有策略意识的多阶段规划框架，来应对复杂任务中生成高质量自然语言可执行计划的挑战。GRASP 将规划流程解耦为相互隔离上下文的专门模块：GenPlan 预编译全局宏观指南，RevPlan 在隔离的上下文窗口中探索替代的局部策略，而 VerPlan 使用多标准判别器独立评估轨迹。实证评估表明，GRASP 在多种数据集上持续建立新的最先进水平：相对于直接 LLM 规划器，在 Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling 上准确率提高约 12.4%，在 ZebraLogic 上提高约 30.8%，并在 SciBench Math 上取得提升。关键的是，在标准规划器会立即发生性能崩溃的多任务扩展场景中，GRASP 完全拉平了多任务退化惩罚。在交错双任务环境中，GRASP 相对于直接 LLM 规划器取得最高 16.7 个百分点的绝对准确率提升。此外，通过隔离上下文并实施严格的宏观正则化，GRASP 以 14.5 个百分点的幅度超过了前沿推理模型（例如 GPT-5-mini）。
items.author_line: Arunabh Srivastava, Mohammad A., Khojastepour, Srimat Chakradhar, Sennur Ulukus

items.title: MolDesignBench: Evaluating LLM-based Agent for Scenario-grounded Molecular Design
items.abstract_or_text: Real-world molecular design remains challenging for large language model (LLM)-based agents. It requires them to interpret design contexts, satisfy multiple constraints, identify infeasible specifications, and reason over multi-step tool outputs. Existing benchmarks do not capture this complexity, focusing instead on explicit and narrow constraints, only feasible problems, and single-path solutions. To address this gap, we propose MolDesignBench, a scenario-grounded benchmark that more closely reflects real-world molecular design for evaluating tool-augmented LLM agents. MolDesignBench comprises 2K generation and optimization instances that combine implicit requirements embedded in design narratives with explicit property and functional-group constraints, including infeasible cases, and require the effective use of 17 specialized chemistry tools. Experiments across diverse frontier LLMs reveal low success rates--with the best achieving only \sim43\%--and frequent failures in implicit-constraint reasoning, infeasibility detection, and tool reasoning. The corresponding fine-grained failure-mode analysis identifies implicit constraint interpretation and infeasibility detection as the primary bottlenecks, establishing MolDesignBench as a rigorous testbed to guide future research on chemical agents. The benchmark, tool interface, and evaluation code are publicly available.

items.title: LOCKR: A Hidden-State Trajectory-Guided Planner for Detecting and Repairing Stable-but-Wrong Lock-In in Diffusion Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion language models generate text through iterative denoising, exposing intermediate trajectories before final answers are produced. We identify a recurring reasoning failure, stable-but-wrong lock-in, where an answer stabilizes early around an incorrect value while substantial denoising remains. Surface-level decoding signals such as confidence, entropy, margin, and answer stability are insufficient to reliably distinguish correct from erroneous lock-in. We formulate selective reasoning repair as a lightweight test-time planning problem and propose LOCKR, a hidden-state trajectory-guided planner that decides when to allocate additional computation, expands a structured set of targeted repair branches, and selects the most promising continuation using trajectory-aware verification. Across two diffusion language models and three mathematical reasoning benchmarks, hidden-state trajectories consistently outperform surface signals and single hidden snapshots for both wrong-lock-in detection and repair selection. On natural evaluation distributions, LOCKR yields absolute accuracy gains of 2.21--5.37 percentage points across all five evaluated settings, with repair rates ranging from 22% to 41%. These results establish hidden diffusion trajectories as actionable signals for selective test-time reasoning repair.

items.title: An open benchmark for machine learning-based polymer property prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Polymer property prediction lacks open, standardized benchmarks that enable rigorous comparison of machine-learning methods, with existing resources covering only a narrow fraction of polymer architectures, such as homopolymers. We introduce Polymer Benchmark 2026 (PolyBench26), an open dataset comprising nearly 250,000 polymer-property datapoints across eight physical properties, including data from experimental measurements, density functional theory, and molecular dynamics. The benchmark supports four evaluation tasks across homopolymers and alternating, random, and block copolymers: in-distribution property prediction, dataset-size scaling, repeat-unit complexity, and transfer to held-out polymer architectures. We compare language model, graph-based, and descriptor-based approaches and find graph-based models provide the lowest errors in property prediction, retain their advantage across the evaluated training-set sizes, and remain robust to increasing repeat-unit complexity. PolyBench26 provides a reproducible foundation for developing models for the increasingly complex polymer design space. The PolyBench26 benchmark is available open-source at https://github.com/rlearsch/PolymerBenchmark2026.

items.title: Deep Generative Crystal Structure Prediction: A Benchmark Study and a Controlled Test of Prototype Dependence
items.abstract_or_text: Deep generative models are widely reported to enable de novo crystal structure prediction (CSP), but their capability has not been measured consistently against template-based methods. We evaluate 12 representative generative CSP models, spanning latent-variable, diffusion, flow-matching, autoregressive, and manifold random-walk architectures, against TCSP 2.0 on 180 test structures and a leakage-controlled subset of 46. All methods use identical structure-matching, symmetry, and consensus criteria. Template retrieval is the strongest single method, reaching 68.3% top-1 success; symmetry-aware EquiCSP (66.4%) and Uni-3DAR (62.9%) form the next tier. However, comparison with TCSP 2.0 shows that most structures correctly predicted by generative models are also correctly predicted by template substitution. Thus, the set of structures uniquely reachable by generation is small, limiting its practical advantage for discovering structures outside existing prototype libraries. To test the source of this performance, we removed entire stoichiometric prototype families from the training set and retrained the strongest generative model. Accuracy declined by 50-78% across four families, establishing that performance is substantially prototype-dependent. A small minority of structures survived removal of their prototype family, demonstrating a real but limited retrieval-independent predictive capacity. Present generative CSP models therefore function largely as implicit, softer-edged prototype libraries rather than genuinely de novo predictors. Enlarging this residual capacity, rather than aggregate match rate alone, is the central open problem.

items.abstract_zh: 生成式模型被广泛认为能够实现从头晶体结构预测（CSP），但其能力尚未与基于模板的方法进行一致测量。我们在180个测试结构以及一个经过泄漏控制、包含46个结构的子集上，依据 TCSP 2.0 评估12种代表性生成式 CSP 模型，涵盖潜变量、扩散、flow-matching、自回归和流形随机游走架构。所有方法使用相同的结构匹配、对称性和共识标准。模板检索是最强的单一方法，top-1 成功率达到68.3%；具备对称性感知的 EquiCSP（66.4%）和 Uni-3DAR（62.9%）处于下一梯队。然而，与 TCSP 2.0 的比较表明，生成式模型正确预测的大多数结构也可以通过模板替换正确预测。因此，生成所独有、能够到达的结构集合很小，限制了其发现现有原型库之外结构的实际优势。为检验这一性能来源，我们从训练集中移除完整的化学计量原型家族，并重新训练最强的生成模型。四个家族的准确率下降了50-78%，证明性能在很大程度上依赖原型。少数结构在移除其原型家族后仍然保留，显示出真实但有限的、与检索无关的预测能力。因此，当前生成式 CSP 模型在很大程度上充当隐式且边界更柔和的原型库，而不是真正的从头预测器。扩大这种残余能力，而不仅仅是提高总体匹配率，是该领域的核心开放问题。

items.title: ChipMEM: Verification-Grounded Memory for EDA Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Large language model (LLM)-based agents use Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools to generate and revise register-transfer-level (RTL) designs under synthesis and verification feedback. Recent methods learn from this feedback by distilling reusable skills from execution traces or by training on rewards derived from EDA-tools. Both methods are typically evaluated on the tasks that produced the experience. Repeated access to benchmark feedback on the same task can reward task-specific revision rather than creating reusable knowledge that transfers. We introduce ChipMEM, a verification-grounded memory layer for EDA agents. It combines cross-task procedural memory with within-trajectory statistical guidance. Its procedural component distills and stores a skill only after it passes synthesis, simulation, or formal checks, rather than relying on model self-assessments. A Bayesian component maintains hierarchical Beta estimates over tool-call outcomes and ranks recovery strategies that succeeded under comparable errors. A common adapter applies the same memory interface to RTL optimization and testbench-generation agents while preserving each domain's tools and acceptance criteria. We measure performance on training tasks and evaluate whether learned skills transfer to unseen tasks. On RTLRewriter-Bench, under matched model and tool settings, ChipMEM produces equivalence-passing outputs on 39/54 scored designs versus 35/54 without memory; on the 49-design short suite, mean area improvement is 8.69% versus 5.66%. On held-out CVDP tasks, ChipMEM with a frozen procedural library achieves 20/20 accepted outcomes versus 18/20 without memory in a single evaluation per setting.

items.abstract_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代理使用电子设计自动化（EDA）工具，在综合和验证反馈下生成并修订寄存器传输级（RTL）设计。近期方法通过从执行轨迹中提炼可复用技能，或在 EDA 工具产生的奖励上训练，来利用这些反馈。这两类方法通常都在产生经验的任务上评估。对同一任务反复访问基准反馈，可能奖励面向特定任务的修订，而不是创造可迁移的知识。我们提出 ChipMEM，一种面向 EDA 代理、以验证为基础的记忆层。它结合了跨任务程序记忆与轨迹内统计指导。其程序组件只有在技能通过综合、仿真或形式化检查后才提炼并存储该技能，而不是依赖模型自我评估。一个贝叶斯组件维护工具调用结果的分层 Beta 估计，并对在类似错误下成功的恢复策略排序。一个通用适配器将相同的记忆接口应用于 RTL 优化代理和测试平台生成代理，同时保留各自领域的工具与接受标准。我们在训练任务上测量性能，并评估已学习技能是否能迁移到未见任务。在 RTLRewriter-Bench 上，在模型和工具设置匹配的条件下，ChipMEM 在 54 个计分设计中产生了 39 个通过等价性检查的输出，而无记忆时为 35 个；在 49 个设计的短套件上，平均面积改善为 8.69%，而无记忆时为 5.66%。在留出的 CVDP 任务上，使用冻结程序库的 ChipMEM 在每种设置只进行一次评估时达到 20/20 个接受结果，而无记忆时为 18/20。

items.title: @keithadler：How much shorter can AI make a machine-scale Lean library? I have some answers ... qinz1yang's differential-geometry lib
items.abstract_or_text: How much shorter can AI make a machine-scale Lean library? I have some answers ... qinz1yang's differential-geometry library is 4.7 million lines of Lean with 121,000 theorems, building toward the Poincaré conjecture through Ricci flow. I wanted to know how much of that is proof you need, and how much is proof you could cut. Then I picked 20 proofs at random (30 to 150 lines each, one per file) and had AI rewrite them, with Lean checking every attempt. The rules: only the proof changes, the statement is locked, no sorry, no helper lemmas, no raised limits, and no cramming tactics onto one line. 15 made it all the way through: 835 lines down to 397, 52% fewer lines and 34% fewer characters. Each compiles in its full original file, and Tenet, an independent Lean kernel, accepted every one with its statement unchanged.

items.abstract_or_text: We have completed a Lean 4 proof of Paul D. Hanna's 2016 conjecture in OEIS A266489: every coefficient a(n) is divisible by n for n >= 1. The sequence is defined indirectly. Its normalized generating function A(x) begins 1 + x + 2x^2 + 12x^3 + 132x^4 + 2180x^5 + ..., and the coefficient of x^n in A(x/A(x)^n) vanishes for n > 1. For example, 5 divides a(5)=2180. The proof builds the series coefficient by coefficient, then uses a prime-power coefficient identity and strong induction to assemble the full factor n. This formalization resolves clause C1 as stated; it does not claim the separate mod-2 clause C2 or mathematical priority over unsearched work. #Lean4 #GeneratingFunctions #FormalMath
